schemes.name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
schemes.benefit: ₹6,000/year in 3 installments of ₹2,000 directly in bank account — for all landholding farmer families
schemes.description: Direct income support scheme providing ₹6,000 per year to small and marginal farmer families across India, paid in three equal installments.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
schemes.benefit: Agricultural loan up to ₹3 lakh at 4% interest (with prompt repayment subsidy) — covers crop, animal husbandry, fisheries
schemes.benefitHindi: 4% ब्याज पर ₹3 लाख तक कृषि ऋण — फसल, पशुपालन, मत्स्य पालन
schemes.description: Provides farmers with affordable credit for agricultural operations, allied activities, and consumption needs at subsidized interest rates.

schemes.name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (Crop Insurance)
schemes.benefit: Crop insurance at 1.5% premium (Rabi), 2% (Kharif), 5% (horticulture) — covers losses from drought, flood, pest, hailstorm, cyclone
schemes.benefitHindi: 1.5–5% प्रीमियम पर फसल बीमा — सूखा, बाढ़, कीट, ओलावृष्टि सभी में सुरक्षा
apply_mode: Nearest Bank Branch (auto-enrolled for loanee farmers)
schemes.description: Comprehensive crop insurance scheme protecting farmers against financial losses due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases.

schemes.name: PM Krishi Sinchai Yojana (Irrigation)
schemes.benefit: 55–100% subsidy on micro-irrigation systems (drip/sprinkler) — 'Per Drop More Crop' reduces water usage by 40-70%
schemes.benefitHindi: 55–100% सब्सिडी माइक्रो-सिंचाई पर — ड्रिप/स्प्रिंकलर से 40-70% पानी बचत
schemes.description: Provides subsidized micro-irrigation systems to improve water use efficiency and crop productivity under the 'Per Drop More Crop' initiative.

schemes.name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
schemes.benefit: 40–80% subsidy on farm machinery — tractors, harvesters, power tillers, seed drills, threshers for small/marginal farmers
schemes.benefitHindi: 40–80% सब्सिडी कृषि उपकरणों पर — ट्रैक्टर, हार्वेस्टर, पावर टिलर
schemes.description: Promotes farm mechanization by providing subsidies on agricultural machinery to small and marginal farmers.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
schemes.nameHindi: आयुष्मान भारत प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
schemes.benefit: ₹5 lakh/year free health insurance per family for hospitalization — covers 1,949 treatment packages at 29,000+ empanelled hospitals
schemes.benefitHindi: ₹5 लाख तक मुफ्त इलाज प्रति वर्ष — सरकारी और प्राइवेट अस्पतालों में — 1,949 उपचार शामिल
schemes.description: World's largest health insurance scheme providing ₹5 lakh coverage per family for secondary and tertiary hospitalization across India.

schemes.name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (Maternity Benefit)
schemes.benefit: ₹700–₹1,400 cash assistance to pregnant women for institutional delivery — covers BPL, SC/ST women
schemes.benefitHindi: ₹700–₹1,400 नकद सहायता गर्भवती महिलाओं को अस्पताल में प्रसव के लिए
schemes.description: Cash incentive for pregnant women to encourage institutional delivery, reducing maternal and infant mortality.

schemes.name: PM Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan
schemes.benefit: Free antenatal checkup on 9th of every month for all pregnant women — includes ultrasound, blood tests, high-risk identification
schemes.benefitHindi: हर महीने 9 तारीख को गर्भवती महिलाओं की मुफ्त जांच — अल्ट्रासाउंड, खून जांच शामिल
apply_mode: Government Hospital on 9th of every month
schemes.description: Provides free comprehensive antenatal care to all pregnant women on the 9th of every month at government health facilities.

schemes.name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students
schemes.benefit: ₹150–₹350/month maintenance + ₹500–₹750 ad-hoc grant for students in Class 9–10 from SC/ST families
schemes.description: Financial assistance for SC/ST students in Classes 9-10 to reduce dropout rates and support education.

schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
schemes.benefit: Full tuition fee reimbursement + ₹1,200–₹2,000/month maintenance from Class 11 up to PhD — covers hostellers and day scholars
schemes.benefitHindi: पूरी फीस + ₹1,200–₹2,000 प्रतिमाह छात्रवृत्ति — 11वीं से पीएचडी तक
schemes.description: Comprehensive scholarship covering full tuition and maintenance for SC students pursuing higher education.

schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
schemes.benefit: Tuition fee reimbursement + ₹500–₹1,000/month maintenance for OBC students — Class 11 to Post Graduation
schemes.benefitHindi: ट्यूशन फीस + ₹500–₹1,000 प्रतिमाह — 11वीं से पोस्ट ग्रेजुएशन तक
schemes.description: Financial support for OBC students pursuing higher education from Class 11 onwards.

schemes.name: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Minorities
schemes.benefit: Full tuition fee (up to ₹20,000/year) + ₹1,000/month maintenance — for minority community students in professional/technical courses
schemes.benefitHindi: ₹20,000 तक ट्यूशन फीस + ₹1,000 प्रतिमाह — व्यावसायिक पाठ्यक्रमों के लिए
schemes.description: Scholarship for meritorious students from minority communities pursuing professional and technical courses.

schemes.name: PRAGATI Scholarship for Girls (AICTE)
schemes.benefit: ₹50,000/year for girls pursuing technical education (Engineering, Pharmacy, Architecture, MCA) — up to 2 girls per family
schemes.benefitHindi: ₹50,000 प्रति वर्ष — तकनीकी शिक्षा (इंजीनियरिंग, फार्मेसी, MCA) में पढ़ने वाली लड़कियों के लिए
schemes.description: Promotes technical education among girls by providing ₹50,000/year scholarship for AICTE-approved degree programs.

schemes.name: PM Awas Yojana — Gramin (Rural Housing)
schemes.benefit: ₹1.20 lakh (plain areas) to ₹1.30 lakh (hilly/difficult areas) grant to build a pucca house + 90/95 days MGNREGA wages
schemes.benefitHindi: ₹1.20–₹1.30 लाख पक्का घर बनाने के लिए + मनरेगा मजदूरी 90/95 दिन
documents: Land Documents / NOC from Gram Sabha
schemes.description: Provides financial assistance for construction of pucca houses to eligible rural families living in kutcha/dilapidated houses.

schemes.name: PM Awas Yojana — Urban (PMAY-U 2.0)
schemes.benefit: ₹2.5 lakh central assistance for EWS/LIG + interest subsidy of 6.5% on home loans up to ₹6 lakh — for urban poor
schemes.benefitHindi: ₹2.5 लाख सहायता + 6.5% ब्याज सब्सिडी — शहरी गरीबों के लिए पक्का घर
schemes.description: Affordable housing scheme for urban poor providing direct financial assistance and interest subsidy on home loans.

schemes.name: PM MUDRA Yojana
schemes.benefit: Business loans from ₹50,000 (Shishu) to ₹10 lakh (Tarun) — no collateral required, covers manufacturing, trading, services
schemes.benefitHindi: ₹50,000 (शिशु) से ₹10 लाख (तरुण) तक बिना गारंटी के व्यापार ऋण
schemes.description: Provides collateral-free loans to micro and small enterprises for business creation and expansion in three tiers: Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun.

schemes.name: PM Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
schemes.benefit: 15–35% subsidy on project cost up to ₹50 lakh (manufacturing) / ₹20 lakh (services) — for setting up new micro enterprises
schemes.benefitHindi: 15–35% सब्सिडी परियोजना लागत पर — ₹50 लाख (मैन्युफैक्चरिंग) / ₹20 लाख (सेवा) तक
schemes.description: Generates employment through establishment of micro enterprises with government subsidy in manufacturing and service sectors.

schemes.name: Stand Up India (SC/ST/Women Entrepreneurs)
schemes.benefit: Bank loans between ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore — for SC/ST/Women entrepreneurs setting up greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, or trading
schemes.benefitHindi: ₹10 लाख से ₹1 करोड़ तक बैंक ऋण — SC/ST/महिला उद्यमियों के लिए नया व्यवसाय शुरू करने हेतु
schemes.description: Facilitates bank loans for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs to set up greenfield enterprises.

schemes.name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana (Zero-Balance Account)
schemes.benefit: Free zero-balance bank account + RuPay debit card + ₹2 lakh accident insurance + ₹30,000 life cover + ₹10,000 overdraft facility
schemes.benefitHindi: मुफ्त बैंक खाता + RuPay कार्ड + ₹2 लाख दुर्घटना बीमा + ₹10,000 ओवरड्राफ्ट
documents: Aadhaar Card (or any valid ID proof)
schemes.description: Universal banking scheme ensuring access to financial services for all unbanked households.

schemes.name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (Life Insurance)
schemes.benefit: ₹2 lakh life insurance cover at just ₹436/year — auto-deducted from bank account, covers death due to any reason
schemes.benefitHindi: सिर्फ ₹436/साल में ₹2 लाख का जीवन बीमा — मृत्यु के किसी भी कारण पर
schemes.description: Affordable life insurance scheme providing ₹2 lakh death cover at minimal annual premium.

schemes.name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana (Accident Insurance)
schemes.benefit: ₹2 lakh (death/permanent disability) and ₹1 lakh (partial disability) accident insurance at just ₹20/year
schemes.benefitHindi: केवल ₹20/साल में ₹2 लाख का दुर्घटना बीमा — मृत्यु या स्थायी विकलांगता पर
schemes.description: Ultra-affordable accident insurance providing coverage for accidental death and disability.

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
schemes.benefit: Guaranteed pension of ₹1,000–₹5,000/month after age 60 — government co-contributes 50% for 5 years (for those joining by 2015)
schemes.benefitHindi: 60 वर्ष के बाद ₹1,000–₹5,000 प्रतिमाह गारंटीड पेंशन
schemes.description: Guaranteed pension scheme for unorganized sector workers providing defined pension benefits after age 60.

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (Girl Child Savings)
schemes.benefit: Tax-free savings scheme for girl child at 8.2% interest — maturity at age 21 for education/marriage expenses (min ₹250/year)
schemes.benefitHindi: बेटी की शिक्षा/विवाह के लिए 8.2% ब्याज पर टैक्स-फ्री बचत — 21 वर्ष पर परिपक्वता
schemes.description: Government-backed high-interest savings scheme exclusively for the girl child for education and marriage expenses.

schemes.name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana (Maternity Benefit)
schemes.benefit: ₹11,000 in installments for first 2 live births — ₹3,000 (1st installment) + ₹3,000 (2nd) + ₹2,000 (3rd) + ₹3,000 (at hospital delivery under JSY)
schemes.benefitHindi: ₹11,000 किस्तों में — पहले 2 जीवित जन्मों के लिए गर्भवती और स्तनपान कराने वाली माताओं को
schemes.description: Cash incentive for pregnant and lactating mothers to compensate wage loss during pregnancy and ensure healthy nutrition.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension
schemes.nameHindi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय विधवा पेंशन योजना
schemes.benefit: ₹300/month central share + state top-up (₹500–₹2,000 varies by state) — for BPL widows aged 40-59
schemes.benefitHindi: ₹300/माह केंद्रीय + राज्य टॉप-अप (₹500–₹2,000) — BPL विधवाओं के लिए
schemes.description: Monthly pension for BPL widows to provide social security and financial independence.

schemes.name: One Stop Centre (Sakhi Centre) for Women
schemes.benefit: Free integrated support for women affected by violence — medical aid, legal counselling, police facilitation, psycho-social support, temporary shelter (5 days)
schemes.benefitHindi: हिंसा पीड़ित महिलाओं को मुफ्त चिकित्सा, कानूनी सहायता, पुलिस सहायता, मनोवैज्ञानिक सहारा, अस्थायी आश्रय
documents: No documents required for emergency help
apply_mode: Nearest One Stop Centre (in every district)
schemes.description: 24/7 integrated support centres in every district for women affected by violence, providing medical, legal, and psychological assistance.

schemes.name: PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY)
schemes.benefit: Free skill training (2–6 months) + ₹8,000 reward + government-recognized NSQF certificate + placement assistance + apprenticeship
schemes.benefitHindi: मुफ्त कौशल प्रशिक्षण + ₹8,000 इनाम + NSQF सर्टिफिकेट + नौकरी सहायता + अप्रेंटिसशिप
apply_mode: Nearest PMKVY Training Center (Skill India Portal)
schemes.description: India's flagship skill development scheme providing free industry-relevant training with certification and placement support.

schemes.name: MGNREGA (100 Days Employment Guarantee)
schemes.benefit: Guaranteed 100 days of unskilled manual work per household per year at state minimum wage (₹243–₹374/day) + unemployment allowance if work not provided within 15 days
schemes.benefitHindi: 100 दिन गारंटीड रोजगार — राज्य न्यूनतम मजदूरी (₹243–₹374/दिन) + 15 दिन में काम न मिलने पर बेरोजगारी भत्ता
apply_mode: Gram Panchayat Office (apply for Job Card)
schemes.description: Legal guarantee of 100 days employment per rural household, providing livelihood security to the most vulnerable.

schemes.name: DDU Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
schemes.nameHindi: दीन दयाल उपाध्याय ग्रामीण कौशल्य योजना
schemes.benefit: Free residential skill training (3–12 months) + guaranteed placement at ₹6,000+ salary + free food, accommodation, uniform during training
schemes.benefitHindi: मुफ्त आवासीय प्रशिक्षण (3–12 माह) + ₹6,000+ वेतन पर नौकरी की गारंटी + मुफ्त खाना, रहना, यूनिफॉर्म
schemes.description: Skill training programme exclusively for rural poor youth with guaranteed placement and residential training facilities.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension
schemes.benefit: ₹200/month (60-79 yrs) or ₹500/month (80+ yrs) central share + state top-up (₹500–₹2,500 varies by state)
schemes.benefitHindi: ₹200–₹500/माह केंद्रीय + राज्य टॉप-अप — BPL वृद्ध नागरिकों के लिए
schemes.description: Monthly pension for BPL senior citizens to provide basic financial security in old age.

schemes.name: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana (Free Aids for Seniors)
schemes.benefit: Free physical aids and assistive devices — hearing aids, walking sticks, wheelchairs, spectacles, dentures for BPL senior citizens
schemes.benefitHindi: BPL वृद्ध नागरिकों को मुफ्त सहायक उपकरण — श्रवण यंत्र, व्हीलचेयर, चश्मा, बैसाखी
schemes.description: Provides free assistive devices and aids to BPL senior citizens suffering from age-related disabilities.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension
schemes.benefit: ₹300/month central share + state top-up — for persons with 80%+ disability from BPL families (18-79 years)
schemes.benefitHindi: ₹300/माह + राज्य टॉप-अप — 80%+ विकलांगता वाले BPL परिवार के सदस्यों के लिए
schemes.description: Monthly pension for severely disabled BPL individuals to ensure basic financial support.

schemes.name: ADIP Scheme (Assistive Devices for Disabled)
schemes.nameHindi: ADIP योजना — विकलांगों को सहायक उपकरण
schemes.benefit: Free/subsidized assistive devices — hearing aids (₹25,000+), motorized tricycles, artificial limbs, cochlear implants, braille kits
schemes.benefitHindi: मुफ्त/सब्सिडी पर सहायक उपकरण — श्रवण यंत्र, मोटर ट्राइसाइकल, कृत्रिम अंग, कॉक्लियर इम्प्लांट
schemes.description: Provides free assistive aids and appliances to persons with disabilities for improved mobility and functionality.

schemes.name: National Food Security Act (Ration Card)
schemes.nameHindi: राष्ट्रीय खाद्य सुरक्षा अधिनियम — राशन कार्ड
schemes.benefit: 5 kg foodgrains/person/month at ₹1 (rice), ₹2 (wheat), ₹3 (coarse grains) — for 81 crore people under AAY/PHH
schemes.benefitHindi: ₹1–₹3/kg पर 5 किलो अनाज प्रति व्यक्ति प्रतिमाह — राशन कार्ड धारकों के लिए
apply_mode: Apply for ration card at Tehsil / Block Office
schemes.description: Provides subsidized foodgrains to approximately 81 crore people through the Public Distribution System.

schemes.name: PM POSHAN (Mid-Day Meal) Scheme
schemes.benefit: Free hot cooked meal with 450–700 calories + 12–20g protein daily to all children in government/aided schools (Class 1–8)
schemes.benefitHindi: सरकारी स्कूलों में कक्षा 1–8 के बच्चों को प्रतिदिन मुफ्त पका हुआ भोजन — 450–700 कैलोरी
documents: School Enrollment (no documents needed from parents)
apply_mode: Automatically available in all government/aided schools
schemes.description: Free nutritious meals in government schools to improve school attendance, nutrition, and learning outcomes.

schemes.name: Kanya Sumangala Yojana (UP)
schemes.benefit: ₹15,000 in 6 installments from birth to graduation — ₹2,000 at birth, ₹1,000 at vaccination, ₹2,000 at Class 1, ₹2,000 at Class 6, ₹3,000 at Class 9, ₹5,000 at graduation
schemes.benefitHindi: ₹15,000 छह किस्तों में — जन्म से स्नातक तक बेटियों के लिए
schemes.description: UP government scheme providing ₹15,000 in 6 installments from birth to graduation to support the girl child.

schemes.name: UP Vridhavastha Pension Yojana
schemes.benefit: ₹1,000/month pension for senior citizens (60+) from BPL families in Uttar Pradesh
schemes.benefitHindi: ₹1,000 प्रतिमाह पेंशन — 60 वर्ष से अधिक BPL वृद्ध नागरिकों के लिए
schemes.description: State pension scheme for BPL senior citizens in Uttar Pradesh.

schemes.name: Lek Ladki Yojana (Maharashtra)
schemes.benefit: ₹1,01,000 in installments from birth to age 18 for girls from economically weaker families — Yellow/Orange ration card holders
schemes.benefitHindi: ₹1,01,000 किस्तों में — जन्म से 18 वर्ष तक बेटियों के लिए (पीला/नारंगी राशन कार्ड धारक)
schemes.description: Maharashtra government scheme providing ₹1,01,000 in installments for girls from economically weaker families.

schemes.name: Majhi Kanya Bhagyashree (Maharashtra)
schemes.benefit: ₹50,000 fixed deposit for girl child after mother undergoes sterilization (1 daughter) or ₹25,000 each (2 daughters)
schemes.description: Maharashtra scheme providing financial support through fixed deposits for families with girl children who adopt family planning.

schemes.name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Marriage Assistance (TN)
schemes.benefit: ₹25,000 marriage assistance + 4g gold for thali (mangalsutra) for women graduates from poor families in Tamil Nadu
schemes.benefitHindi: ₹25,000 विवाह सहायता + 4 ग्राम सोना थाली के लिए — तमिलनाडु की गरीब स्नातक महिलाओं के लिए
schemes.description: Tamil Nadu scheme providing marriage assistance including gold and cash for women graduates from economically weaker families.

schemes.name: Chiranjeevi Swasthya Bima Yojana (Rajasthan)
schemes.benefit: ₹25 lakh/year free health insurance per family for hospitalization — covers 1,576 packages + ₹10 lakh for critical illnesses like cancer, heart disease
schemes.benefitHindi: ₹25 लाख/वर्ष मुफ्त स्वास्थ्य बीमा + ₹10 लाख गंभीर बीमारियों (कैंसर, हृदय रोग) के लिए
schemes.description: Rajasthan's flagship universal health insurance scheme covering ₹25 lakh per family per year.

schemes.name: Lakshmir Bhandar (West Bengal)
schemes.benefit: ₹500/month (General) or ₹1,000/month (SC/ST) direct income support for women aged 25-60 — head of household
schemes.benefitHindi: ₹500/माह (सामान्य) या ₹1,000/माह (SC/ST) — 25-60 वर्ष की महिला परिवार प्रमुख को सीधे बैंक में
schemes.description: West Bengal income support scheme providing monthly direct benefit transfer to women household heads.

schemes.name: PM Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 (Free LPG Connection)
schemes.benefit: Free LPG connection + first refill free + free stove — for BPL women, SC/ST households, no documents needed (just Aadhaar + self-declaration)
schemes.benefitHindi: मुफ्त LPG कनेक्शन + पहला रिफिल मुफ्त + मुफ्त चूल्हा — BPL, SC/ST महिलाओं के लिए
schemes.description: Provides free LPG connections to BPL women, replacing unhealthy cooking fuels with clean LPG gas.

schemes.name: PM Gram Sadak Yojana (Rural Roads)
schemes.benefit: All-weather road connectivity to habitations with 500+ population (250+ in hilly/tribal areas) — community benefit scheme
schemes.benefitHindi: 500+ आबादी वाले गाँवों को पक्की सड़क से जोड़ना (पहाड़ी/जनजातीय क्षेत्रों में 250+)
documents: Community benefit — no individual application needed
schemes.description: Provides all-weather road connectivity to unconnected rural habitations across India.

schemes.name: Swachh Bharat Mission 2.0 (Free Toilet)
schemes.benefit: ₹12,000 assistance for construction of individual household toilet + solid/liquid waste management at village level
schemes.benefitHindi: ₹12,000 सहायता व्यक्तिगत शौचालय निर्माण के लिए + गाँव स्तर पर कचरा प्रबंधन
schemes.description: Provides financial assistance for toilet construction in rural households to achieve Open Defecation Free status.

schemes.name: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana (Free Solar)
schemes.nameHindi: पीएम सूर्य घर मुफ्त बिजली योजना
schemes.benefit: ₹30,000–₹78,000 subsidy on rooftop solar panels — get 300 units free electricity/month, sell excess to grid, reduce bill to zero
schemes.benefitHindi: ₹30,000–₹78,000 सब्सिडी छत पर सोलर पैनल के लिए — 300 यूनिट मुफ्त बिजली/माह
schemes.description: Massive subsidy on rooftop solar installations enabling households to generate free electricity and become energy independent.

schemes.name: PM Kisan Maandhan Yojana
schemes.brief: Monthly pension of ₹3,000 for small and marginal farmers after 60
schemes.briefHindi: छोटे और सीमांत किसानों को 60 वर्ष के बाद ₹3,000 मासिक पेंशन
schemes.benefit: ₹3,000/month guaranteed pension after age 60 for small/marginal farmers with up to 2 hectares land
schemes.benefitHindi: 60 वर्ष के बाद ₹3,000/माह पेंशन — 2 हेक्टेयर तक भूमि वाले किसानों के लिए
schemes.description: Voluntary pension scheme for small and marginal farmers to ensure old age protection.

schemes.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
schemes.brief: Free soil testing and crop-specific nutrient recommendations
schemes.briefHindi: मुफ्त मिट्टी परीक्षण और फसल-विशिष्ट पोषक तत्व सिफारिशें
schemes.benefit: Free soil testing with personalized crop-wise fertilizer recommendations for all farmers — issued every 2 years
schemes.benefitHindi: सभी किसानों को मुफ्त मिट्टी परीक्षण — हर 2 साल में फसलवार खाद सिफारिशें
schemes.description: Provides soil health cards to farmers with crop-wise nutrient recommendations.

schemes.name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana
schemes.brief: ₹50,000/hectare subsidy for organic farming clusters
schemes.briefHindi: जैविक खेती के लिए ₹50,000/हेक्टेयर सब्सिडी
schemes.benefit: ₹50,000 per hectare over 3 years for organic farming cluster formation — covers inputs, certification & marketing
schemes.benefitHindi: 3 वर्षों में ₹50,000/हेक्टेयर जैविक खेती के लिए — इनपुट, प्रमाणीकरण और विपणन
schemes.description: Promotes organic farming through cluster approach with financial assistance.

schemes.name: PM Matsya Sampada Yojana
schemes.department: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry & Dairying
schemes.brief: 40-60% subsidy for fisheries infrastructure and aquaculture
schemes.briefHindi: मत्स्य पालन बुनियादी ढांचे के लिए 40-60% सब्सिडी
schemes.benefit: 40% subsidy (60% for SC/ST/women) on fisheries infrastructure — ponds, boats, cold storage, feed mills up to ₹25 Lakh
schemes.benefitHindi: मत्स्य पालन पर 40% सब्सिडी (SC/ST/महिलाओं के लिए 60%) — तालाब, नाव, कोल्ड स्टोरेज
schemes.description: Blue Revolution scheme for sustainable fisheries development with subsidy support.

schemes.name: Micro Irrigation Fund (PMKSY)
schemes.brief: 55% subsidy on drip and sprinkler irrigation systems
schemes.briefHindi: ड्रिप और स्प्रिंकलर सिंचाई पर 55% सब्सिडी
schemes.benefit: 55% subsidy for small/marginal farmers (45% for others) on drip & sprinkler micro irrigation systems
schemes.benefitHindi: छोटे/सीमांत किसानों को 55% सब्सिडी (अन्य को 45%) ड्रिप और स्प्रिंकलर सिंचाई पर
schemes.description: Promotes micro-irrigation for water-use efficiency and crop productivity.

schemes.name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana
schemes.brief: Infrastructure grants for agricultural innovation projects
schemes.briefHindi: कृषि नवाचार परियोजनाओं के लिए अवसंरचना अनुदान
schemes.benefit: Project-based grants for agri-innovation, agri-startups (up to ₹25 Lakh), and farm mechanization
schemes.benefitHindi: कृषि नवाचार, कृषि-स्टार्टअप (₹25 लाख तक), और कृषि यंत्रीकरण के लिए अनुदान
schemes.description: Incentivizes states to increase public investment in agriculture and allied sectors.

schemes.name: Nikshay Poshan Yojana
schemes.brief: ₹500/month nutrition support for TB patients
schemes.briefHindi: टीबी रोगियों को ₹500/माह पोषण सहायता
schemes.benefit: ₹500 per month direct benefit transfer for nutritional support to all notified TB patients during treatment
schemes.benefitHindi: सभी अधिसूचित टीबी रोगियों को उपचार के दौरान पोषण सहायता के लिए ₹500 प्रति माह DBT
schemes.description: Monthly nutritional support for TB patients to improve treatment outcomes.

schemes.name: PM National Dialysis Programme
schemes.brief: Free dialysis for BPL patients at district hospitals
schemes.briefHindi: जिला अस्पतालों में BPL रोगियों को मुफ्त डायलिसिस
schemes.benefit: Free hemodialysis at district hospitals for BPL patients — covers 3 sessions/week at PPP dialysis units
schemes.benefitHindi: BPL रोगियों को जिला अस्पतालों में मुफ्त हीमोडायलिसिस — सप्ताह में 3 सत्र
schemes.description: Free dialysis services for BPL patients at district hospital PPP units.

schemes.name: National AYUSH Mission
schemes.brief: Free Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy services
schemes.briefHindi: मुफ्त आयुर्वेद, योग, यूनानी, सिद्ध, होम्योपैथी सेवाएं
schemes.benefit: Free AYUSH treatment at government health centres and AYUSH hospitals — traditional Indian medicine access
schemes.benefitHindi: सरकारी स्वास्थ्य केंद्रों और AYUSH अस्पतालों में मुफ्त AYUSH उपचार
schemes.description: Provides free access to traditional Indian medicine systems through government facilities.

schemes.name: PM YASASVI Scholarship
schemes.brief: ₹75,000-₹1,25,000/year for OBC/EBC/DNT students
schemes.briefHindi: OBC/EBC/DNT छात्रों को ₹75,000-₹1,25,000/वर्ष छात्रवृत्ति
schemes.benefit: ₹75,000/year for Class 9-10 and ₹1,25,000/year for Class 11-12 students from OBC, EBC, and DNT categories
schemes.benefitHindi: कक्षा 9-10 के लिए ₹75,000/वर्ष और कक्षा 11-12 के लिए ₹1,25,000/वर्ष — OBC/EBC/DNT छात्र
schemes.description: Merit-cum-means scholarship for OBC/EBC/DNT students in Class 9 to 12.

schemes.name: INSPIRE Scholarship (DST)
schemes.brief: ₹80,000/year for top 1% science students in BSc/BS
schemes.briefHindi: BSc/BS में शीर्ष 1% विज्ञान छात्रों को ₹80,000/वर्ष
schemes.benefit: ₹80,000 per year scholarship for BSc/BS/integrated MS students among top 1% in Class 12 Science board exams
schemes.benefitHindi: कक्षा 12 विज्ञान बोर्ड परीक्षा में शीर्ष 1% छात्रों को BSc/BS के लिए ₹80,000/वर्ष
schemes.description: Scholarship for top science students to pursue basic and natural sciences.

schemes.name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship
schemes.brief: ₹12,000/year for meritorious Class 9-12 students from EWS
schemes.briefHindi: EWS के मेधावी कक्षा 9-12 छात्रों को ₹12,000/वर्ष
schemes.benefit: ₹12,000 per year (₹1,000/month) for meritorious students from economically weaker sections studying in Class 9-12 at government schools
schemes.description: Encourages meritorious students from economically weaker families to continue education.

schemes.name: Maulana Azad National Fellowship
schemes.brief: ₹31,000/month for minority PhD scholars
schemes.briefHindi: अल्पसंख्यक पीएचडी शोधार्थियों को ₹31,000/माह
schemes.benefit: ₹31,000/month (JRF) escalating to ₹35,000/month (SRF) for minority community students pursuing MPhil/PhD + HRA + contingency
schemes.benefitHindi: MPhil/PhD कर रहे अल्पसंख्यक छात्रों को ₹31,000/माह (JRF) से ₹35,000/माह (SRF) + HRA
schemes.description: Research fellowship for minority community students pursuing MPhil/PhD.

schemes.name: Top Class Education for SC Students
schemes.nameHindi: अनुसूचित जाति छात्रों के लिए उत्कृष्ट शिक्षा
schemes.brief: Full tuition at IITs/IIMs/NITs/AIIMS for SC students
schemes.briefHindi: SC छात्रों को IIT/IIM/NIT/AIIMS में पूर्ण ट्यूशन
schemes.benefit: Full tuition fees + maintenance allowance at premier institutions (IITs, IIMs, NITs, AIIMS, NLUs) for SC students with family income below ₹8 Lakh
schemes.benefitHindi: ₹8 लाख से कम आय वाले SC छात्रों को IIT/IIM/NIT/AIIMS में पूर्ण ट्यूशन + रखरखाव भत्ता
schemes.description: Covers full tuition for SC students at India's top educational institutions.

schemes.name: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship
schemes.department: Ministry of Minority Affairs (Maulana Azad Education Foundation)
schemes.brief: ₹5,000-₹6,000 for minority girls in Class 9-12
schemes.benefit: ₹5,000 for Class 9-10 and ₹6,000 for Class 11-12 minority girls with marks above 50% and family income below ₹2 Lakh
schemes.description: Scholarship for meritorious minority girls studying in Class 9-12.

schemes.name: PMAY-Gramin (Rural Housing)
schemes.brief: ₹1.20 Lakh (plains) / ₹1.30 Lakh (hills) for rural pucca house
schemes.briefHindi: ग्रामीण पक्का मकान — ₹1.20 लाख (मैदान) / ₹1.30 लाख (पहाड़)
schemes.benefit: ₹1,20,000 for plains and ₹1,30,000 for hilly/difficult areas for construction of pucca house with toilet — including 90 days MGNREGA wages
schemes.description: Financial assistance for construction of pucca houses for houseless rural poor.

schemes.name: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendors)
schemes.brief: ₹10,000-₹50,000 micro-credit for street vendors at 7% interest subsidy
schemes.briefHindi: पथ विक्रेताओं को 7% ब्याज सब्सिडी पर ₹10,000-₹50,000 ऋण
schemes.benefit: Working capital loan: 1st tranche ₹10,000, 2nd tranche ₹20,000, 3rd tranche ₹50,000 — with 7% annual interest subsidy on timely repayment
schemes.benefitHindi: कार्यशील पूंजी ऋण: ₹10,000 → ₹20,000 → ₹50,000 — समय पर भुगतान पर 7% ब्याज सब्सिडी
documents: Certificate of Vending / Letter of Recommendation
schemes.description: Affordable working capital loans for street vendors to restart livelihoods.

schemes.name: DAY-NULM (Urban Livelihoods)
schemes.nameHindi: दीनदयाल अंत्योदय योजना — राष्ट्रीय शहरी आजीविका मिशन
schemes.brief: Self-employment training + ₹2 Lakh loan for urban poor SHGs
schemes.briefHindi: शहरी गरीब SHG को स्वरोजगार प्रशिक्षण + ₹2 लाख ऋण
schemes.benefit: Skills training, self-employment loans up to ₹2 Lakh for SHGs, ₹10 Lakh for group enterprises — shelter for urban homeless
schemes.benefitHindi: कौशल प्रशिक्षण, SHG को ₹2 लाख तक स्वरोजगार ऋण, समूह उद्यम ₹10 लाख — बेघरों को आश्रय
schemes.description: Reduces urban poverty through skills training, self-employment, and shelter.

schemes.name: PM CARES for Children
schemes.brief: ₹10 Lakh corpus at age 23 + free education for COVID orphans
schemes.briefHindi: COVID अनाथ बच्चों को 23 वर्ष की आयु में ₹10 लाख + मुफ्त शिक्षा
schemes.benefit: ₹10 Lakh at age 23, monthly stipend from PM CARES fund, free education from primary to professional level, free health insurance under Ayushman Bharat
schemes.benefitHindi: 23 वर्ष पर ₹10 लाख, मासिक वजीफा, प्राथमिक से पेशेवर स्तर तक मुफ्त शिक्षा, आयुष्मान भारत में मुफ्त बीमा
schemes.description: Comprehensive support for children who lost parents during the pandemic.

schemes.name: Scheme for Adolescent Girls (SAG)
schemes.brief: Nutrition, health, education support for out-of-school girls 11-14
schemes.briefHindi: 11-14 वर्ष की स्कूल से बाहर लड़कियों को पोषण, स्वास्थ्य, शिक्षा
schemes.benefit: Supplementary nutrition (600 cal/day + 18g protein), iron-folic acid, health check-ups, life skills education for out-of-school girls 11-14 yrs
schemes.benefitHindi: 11-14 वर्ष की स्कूल से बाहर बालिकाओं को पूरक पोषण, आयरन-फोलिक एसिड, स्वास्थ्य जांच, जीवन कौशल
schemes.description: Empowers adolescent girls through nutrition, health, and life skills support.

schemes.name: ICDS (Integrated Child Dev Services)
schemes.brief: Free supplementary nutrition for children 0-6 and pregnant women
schemes.briefHindi: 0-6 वर्ष के बच्चों और गर्भवती महिलाओं को मुफ्त पूरक पोषण
schemes.benefit: Free supplementary nutrition, immunization, health check-ups, pre-school education for children 0-6 yrs and pregnant/lactating mothers through Anganwadi
schemes.benefitHindi: आंगनवाड़ी में 0-6 वर्ष के बच्चों और गर्भवती/स्तनपान कराने वाली माताओं को मुफ्त पोषण, टीकाकरण, प्री-स्कूल
schemes.description: World's largest early childhood care program serving through 14 lakh Anganwadi centres.

schemes.name: Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya
schemes.brief: Free residential schools for girls from SC/ST/OBC/minority communities
schemes.briefHindi: SC/ST/OBC/अल्पसंख्यक लड़कियों के लिए मुफ्त आवासीय विद्यालय
schemes.benefit: Free residential education (Class 6-12) for girls from SC/ST/OBC/minority/BPL families in educationally backward blocks
schemes.benefitHindi: शैक्षिक रूप से पिछड़े ब्लॉक में SC/ST/OBC/अल्पसंख्यक/BPL परिवारों की बालिकाओं को कक्षा 6-12 तक मुफ्त आवासीय शिक्षा
schemes.description: Free residential schools empowering girls from marginalized communities.

schemes.name: Senior Citizen Savings Scheme (SCSS)
schemes.brief: 8.2% interest for citizens 60+ — up to ₹30 Lakh deposit
schemes.briefHindi: 60+ नागरिकों के लिए 8.2% ब्याज — ₹30 लाख तक जमा
schemes.benefit: 8.2% annual interest with quarterly payouts, maximum deposit ₹30 Lakh, 5-year maturity, tax deduction under Section 80C up to ₹1.5 Lakh
schemes.benefitHindi: 8.2% वार्षिक ब्याज (तिमाही भुगतान), ₹30 लाख तक जमा, 5 वर्ष परिपक्वता, 80C कर छूट ₹1.5 लाख तक
schemes.description: Safe, high-yield savings instrument exclusively for senior citizens.

schemes.name: PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0
schemes.brief: Free skill training in 600+ courses with ₹8,000 stipend
schemes.briefHindi: 600+ पाठ्यक्रमों में मुफ्त कौशल प्रशिक्षण + ₹8,000 स्टाइपेंड
schemes.benefit: Free short-term skill training (2-6 months) in 600+ courses, ₹8,000 stipend, industry-recognized certification, placement assistance
schemes.benefitHindi: 600+ कोर्स में 2-6 माह मुफ्त कौशल प्रशिक्षण, ₹8,000 स्टाइपेंड, उद्योग प्रमाणपत्र, प्लेसमेंट सहायता
schemes.description: India's largest skill development program with industry-aligned certification.

schemes.name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme
schemes.brief: ₹1,500/month stipend support for apprentices + training
schemes.briefHindi: प्रशिक्षुओं को ₹1,500/माह वजीफा + प्रशिक्षण
schemes.benefit: Government shares 25% of stipend (up to ₹1,500/month) and covers basic training cost (up to ₹7,500) for apprentices in establishments
schemes.benefitHindi: सरकार 25% वजीफा (₹1,500/माह तक) + मूल प्रशिक्षण लागत (₹7,500 तक) वहन करती है
schemes.description: Promotes apprenticeship training by sharing costs with employers.

schemes.name: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - NRLM
schemes.nameHindi: दीनदयाल अंत्योदय योजना — राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण आजीविका मिशन
schemes.brief: SHG revolving fund ₹10,000-₹15,000 + skill training for rural women
schemes.briefHindi: ग्रामीण महिलाओं को SHG रिवॉल्विंग फंड ₹10,000-₹15,000 + कौशल प्रशिक्षण
schemes.benefit: Revolving fund ₹10,000-₹15,000 per SHG, Community Investment Fund up to ₹2.5 Lakh, free skill training, interest subvention on bank loans
schemes.benefitHindi: प्रति SHG ₹10,000-₹15,000 रिवॉल्विंग फंड, ₹2.5 लाख तक सामुदायिक निवेश कोष, मुफ्त कौशल प्रशिक्षण
schemes.description: Largest women's livelihood mission organizing 10 Crore+ women into SHGs.

schemes.name: PM Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
schemes.brief: Free LPG connection + first refill for BPL women
schemes.briefHindi: BPL महिलाओं को मुफ्त LPG कनेक्शन + पहला रिफिल
schemes.benefit: Free LPG connection with deposit-free cylinder, free first refill, free stove for BPL/SC/ST/Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana beneficiaries
schemes.benefitHindi: BPL/SC/ST/PMAY लाभार्थी महिलाओं को मुफ्त LPG कनेक्शन, जमा-मुक्त सिलेंडर, मुफ्त पहला रिफिल, मुफ्त चूल्हा
schemes.description: Clean cooking fuel access for BPL families to eliminate smoke-related health risks.

schemes.name: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana
schemes.nameHindi: पीएम सूर्य घर मुफ्त बिजली योजना
schemes.brief: ₹78,000 subsidy on rooftop solar — 300 units free electricity/month
schemes.briefHindi: छत पर सोलर पर ₹78,000 सब्सिडी — 300 यूनिट मुफ्त बिजली/माह
schemes.benefit: Central subsidy: ₹30,000 for 1kW, ₹60,000 for 2kW, ₹78,000 for 3kW+ rooftop solar — 300 units free electricity per month, surplus sold to grid
schemes.description: ₹75,000 Crore scheme to install rooftop solar on 1 Crore households.

schemes.name: PM KUSUM (Solar Pumps)
schemes.brief: 60% subsidy on solar pumps for farmers — replace diesel pumps
schemes.briefHindi: किसानों को सोलर पंप पर 60% सब्सिडी — डीजल पंप की जगह
schemes.benefit: 60% subsidy (30% central + 30% state) on standalone solar pumps up to 7.5HP — farmers keep the remaining 40% (30% bank loan + 10% self)
schemes.benefitHindi: 7.5HP तक सोलर पंप पर 60% सब्सिडी (30% केंद्र + 30% राज्य) — किसान शेष 40% वहन करें
schemes.description: Solarizes agricultural pumps to reduce farmer electricity costs and carbon emissions.

schemes.name: Kanya Sumangala Yojana (UP)
schemes.brief: ₹15,000 in 6 installments for girl child birth to graduation
schemes.briefHindi: बेटी के जन्म से स्नातक तक 6 किस्तों में ₹15,000
schemes.benefit: ₹15,000 in 6 installments: ₹2,000 at birth, ₹1,000 at 1yr vaccination, ₹2,000 at Class 1, ₹2,000 at Class 6, ₹3,000 at Class 9, ₹5,000 at graduation
schemes.description: UP's flagship scheme supporting girl child from birth through graduation.

schemes.name: Mahatma Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MH)
schemes.brief: Free cashless treatment up to ₹1.5 Lakh for BPL families in MH
schemes.briefHindi: महाराष्ट्र में BPL परिवारों को ₹1.5 लाख तक मुफ्त कैशलेस इलाज
schemes.benefit: Cashless treatment up to ₹1.5 Lakh per family per year for 971 surgeries at network hospitals — covers all ration card holders in Maharashtra
schemes.benefitHindi: महाराष्ट्र में राशन कार्ड धारकों को नेटवर्क अस्पतालों में 971 सर्जरी ₹1.5 लाख/वर्ष तक कैशलेस
schemes.description: Maharashtra's public health insurance covering 971 surgical procedures.

schemes.name: Majhi Kanya Bhagyashree (MH)
schemes.brief: ₹50,000 bond + insurance for girl child in MH
schemes.briefHindi: महाराष्ट्र में बेटी के लिए ₹50,000 बॉन्ड + बीमा
schemes.benefit: ₹50,000 at girl's birth (deposited in bank), ₹1 Lakh accident insurance for mother, interest benefit at 18 years, family income < ₹7.5L
schemes.benefitHindi: बेटी के जन्म पर ₹50,000 (बैंक में जमा), मां को ₹1 लाख दुर्घटना बीमा, 18 वर्ष पर ब्याज सहित भुगतान
schemes.description: Maharashtra's girl child benefit scheme with birth deposit and insurance.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana (Bihar)
schemes.brief: ₹50,000 for girls graduating from Bihar — birth to graduation support
schemes.briefHindi: बिहार से स्नातक करने वाली लड़कियों को ₹50,000 — जन्म से स्नातक तक सहायता
schemes.benefit: ₹50,000 to girls on graduation (₹25,000 for intermediate), ₹2,000 at birth, ₹1,000 for Aadhaar linkage, ₹2,000 for complete immunization
schemes.description: Bihar's flagship girl child education scheme from birth to graduation.

schemes.name: Kanyashree Prakalpa (West Bengal)
schemes.brief: ₹25,000 at 18 + ₹750/year for unmarried girls in West Bengal
schemes.briefHindi: पश्चिम बंगाल में अविवाहित लड़कियों को 18 वर्ष पर ₹25,000 + ₹750/वर्ष
schemes.benefit: ₹750 annual scholarship (K1) for girls 13-18 in school/training + ₹25,000 one-time grant (K2) at age 18 if unmarried — family income < ₹1.2L
schemes.benefitHindi: 13-18 वर्ष स्कूल लड़कियों को ₹750/वर्ष + 18 वर्ष अविवाहित पर ₹25,000 — पारिवारिक आय ₹1.2 लाख से कम
schemes.description: UN-awarded scheme to prevent child marriage and promote girls' education in WB.

schemes.name: Rythu Bandhu (Telangana)
schemes.brief: ₹10,000/acre/year for Telangana farmers — both seasons
schemes.briefHindi: तेलंगाना किसानों को ₹10,000/एकड़/वर्ष — दोनों मौसम
schemes.benefit: ₹10,000 per acre per year (₹5,000 per season) directly to farmer bank accounts for all Telangana land-owning farmers — no income limit
schemes.benefitHindi: तेलंगाना के सभी भूस्वामी किसानों को ₹10,000/एकड़/वर्ष (₹5,000/सीजन) सीधे बैंक में — कोई आय सीमा नहीं
schemes.description: Telangana's farmer investment support of ₹10,000/acre/year for agriculture inputs.

schemes.name: Amma Vodi (Andhra Pradesh)
schemes.brief: ₹15,000/year for mothers sending children to school in AP
schemes.briefHindi: AP में बच्चों को स्कूल भेजने वाली माताओं को ₹15,000/वर्ष
schemes.benefit: ₹15,000 per year to mothers/guardians of students from Class 1-12 studying in government/aided schools — direct bank transfer to mother's account
schemes.benefitHindi: कक्षा 1-12 में सरकारी/सहायता प्राप्त स्कूलों में पढ़ने वाले छात्रों की माताओं को ₹15,000/वर्ष — मां के खाते में DBT
schemes.description: AP's unique scheme incentivizing mothers to keep children in school.

schemes.name: Gruha Lakshmi (Karnataka)
schemes.brief: ₹2,000/month to women heads of households in Karnataka
schemes.briefHindi: कर्नाटक में परिवार की मुखिया महिलाओं को ₹2,000/माह
schemes.benefit: ₹2,000 per month (₹24,000/year) to women heads of BPL/APL households with ration card — direct transfer to woman's bank account
schemes.benefitHindi: BPL/APL राशन कार्ड धारक परिवारों की मुखिया महिलाओं को ₹2,000/माह (₹24,000/वर्ष) — महिला के बैंक खाते में
schemes.description: Karnataka's monthly income support for women heads of households.

schemes.name: Free Laptop Scheme (Tamil Nadu)
schemes.brief: Free laptop for government school students joining college in TN
schemes.briefHindi: TN में सरकारी स्कूल से कॉलेज जाने वाले छात्रों को मुफ्त लैपटॉप
schemes.benefit: Free laptop with preloaded educational software for government school students enrolling in higher education (college/polytechnic/ITI) in Tamil Nadu
schemes.benefitHindi: तमिलनाडु में उच्च शिक्षा (कॉलेज/पॉलिटेक्निक/ITI) में नामांकित सरकारी स्कूल छात्रों को मुफ्त लैपटॉप
schemes.description: TN's digital empowerment initiative providing laptops to college-going students.

schemes.name: Ladli Laxmi Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
schemes.brief: ₹1,43,000 to girl child from birth to 21 in MP
schemes.briefHindi: MP में बेटी को जन्म से 21 वर्ष तक ₹1,43,000
schemes.benefit: ₹1,43,000 total: ₹6,000/year for 5 years (National Savings Certificate), ₹2,000 at Class 6, ₹4,000 at Class 9, ₹6,000 at Class 11, ₹1,00,000 at 21 (if unmarried at 18)
schemes.description: MP's comprehensive girl child welfare scheme providing ₹1.43 Lakh from birth to 21.

schemes.name: KALIA Yojana (Odisha)
schemes.brief: ₹10,000/year for small & marginal farmers + ₹12,500 for landless
schemes.benefit: ₹10,000/year (₹5,000/season) for cultivators, ₹12,500/year for landless farm households, ₹2 Lakh life insurance + ₹2 Lakh accident insurance
schemes.benefitHindi: कृषकों को ₹10,000/वर्ष, भूमिहीन कृषि परिवारों को ₹12,500/वर्ष, ₹2 लाख जीवन + ₹2 लाख दुर्घटना बीमा
schemes.description: Odisha's farmer welfare scheme covering cultivators and landless agricultural families.

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
schemes.brief: ₹3 Lakh collateral-free loan at 5% + free toolkit for artisans
schemes.briefHindi: कारीगरों को 5% पर ₹3 लाख बिना गारंटी ऋण + मुफ्त टूलकिट
schemes.benefit: ₹3 Lakh collateral-free loan at 5% interest, free toolkit (up to ₹15,000), ₹500/day training stipend, digital marketing support — for 18 traditional trades
schemes.benefitHindi: 5% ब्याज पर ₹3 लाख बिना गारंटी ऋण, ₹15,000 तक मुफ्त टूलकिट, ₹500/दिन प्रशिक्षण — 18 पारंपरिक व्यवसायों के लिए
schemes.description: End-to-end support for traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 trades.

schemes.name: DigiLocker
schemes.brief: Free cloud storage for government-issued documents — Aadhaar-linked
schemes.briefHindi: सरकारी दस्तावेजों का मुफ्त क्लाउड स्टोरेज — आधार से जुड़ा
schemes.benefit: Free digital locker for all citizens — store Aadhaar, PAN, driving licence, marksheets, certificates issued by government in verified digital format
schemes.benefitHindi: सभी नागरिकों के लिए मुफ्त डिजिटल लॉकर — आधार, PAN, लाइसेंस, मार्कशीट, प्रमाणपत्र डिजिटल रूप में
schemes.description: India's official cloud-based document storage and verification platform.

schemes.name: One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC)
schemes.department: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution
schemes.brief: Get ration from any PDS shop across India with single ration card
schemes.briefHindi: एक ही राशन कार्ड से पूरे भारत में किसी भी PDS दुकान से राशन
schemes.benefit: Portability of ration card — any NFSA beneficiary can lift subsidized foodgrains from any Fair Price Shop in India using existing ration card + Aadhaar
schemes.benefitHindi: राशन कार्ड की पोर्टेबिलिटी — कोई भी NFSA लाभार्थी भारत में किसी भी उचित मूल्य दुकान से सब्सिडी वाला अनाज ले सकता है
schemes.description: Enables migrant workers to access subsidized food from any PDS shop across India.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension
schemes.brief: ₹200-₹500/month pension for BPL elderly 60+
schemes.benefit: ₹200/month for age 60-79 and ₹500/month for 80+ BPL citizens — states often top-up with additional amounts (total ₹500-₹2,000/month)
schemes.description: Central government pension for BPL elderly citizens aged 60 and above.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Van Dhan Vikas Yojana
schemes.brief: Value addition, processing & livelihood clusters for tribal forest gatherers
schemes.briefHindi: आदिवासी वनोपज संग्राहकों के लिए प्रसंस्करण और आजीविका केंद्र
schemes.benefit: ₹15 Lakh per Van Dhan Vikas Kendra for training, equipment, value addition of Minor Forest Produce (MFP) benefiting 300 tribal forest gatherers
schemes.benefitHindi: प्रत्येक वन धन विकास केंद्र को ₹15 लाख — 300 वनोपज संग्राहकों को प्रशिक्षण, मशीनरी व मूल्य संवर्धन सहायता
schemes.description: Promotes value addition and sustainable livelihood for forest-dwelling tribal communities through Van Dhan Kendras.

schemes.name: Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS)
schemes.brief: 100% free quality CBSE residential schooling with boarding for ST students (Class 6-12)
schemes.briefHindi: एसटी विद्यार्थियों के लिए कक्षा 6-12 तक 100% मुफ्त सीबीएसई आवासीय शिक्षा
schemes.benefit: Completely free boarding, lodging, uniforms, books, computers & high-quality CBSE education with coaching for competitive exams (JEE/NEET)
schemes.benefitHindi: पूर्णतः निःशुल्क आवासीय सीबीएसई शिक्षा, भोजन, वर्दी, पुस्तकें एवं जेईई/नीट प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं की कोचिंग
schemes.description: Flagship central scheme providing high-quality residential education to Scheduled Tribe students in remote tribal areas.

schemes.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
schemes.nameHindi: अनुसूचित जनजाति के छात्रों के लिए पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति
schemes.brief: Full tuition fee reimbursement + monthly maintenance allowance for ST students
schemes.briefHindi: एसटी विद्यार्थियों को पूरी ट्यूशन फीस प्रतिपूर्ति और मासिक रखरखाव भत्ता
schemes.benefit: 100% compulsory non-refundable fees reimbursed + ₹1,200/month for hostellers and ₹550/month for day scholars pursuing Class 11 to PhD
schemes.benefitHindi: 100% शिक्षण शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति + छात्रावास हेतु ₹1,200/माह एवं गैर-छात्रावास हेतु ₹550/माह भत्ता
schemes.description: Centrally sponsored scholarship scheme providing full financial assistance to ST students pursuing post-matriculation studies.

schemes.name: National Fellowship and Scholarship for ST Students
schemes.nameHindi: एसटी छात्रों के लिए राष्ट्रीय फेलोशिप और उच्च शिक्षा छात्रवृत्ति
schemes.brief: ₹31,000-₹35,000/month fellowship for ST scholars pursuing M.Phil/Ph.D.
schemes.briefHindi: एम.फिल और पीएचडी कर रहे एसटी शोधार्थियों को ₹31,000-₹35,000/माह फेलोशिप
schemes.benefit: JRF ₹31,000/month and SRF ₹35,000/month + contingency grant of ₹20,000/year for ST scholars doing full-time Ph.D./M.Phil
schemes.benefitHindi: जेआरएफ ₹31,000/माह तथा एसआरएफ ₹35,000/माह + ₹20,000/वर्ष आकस्मिक अनुदान
schemes.description: Direct fellowship awarded to Scheduled Tribe scholars for pursuing research in premier universities.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Janjatiya Unnat Gram Abhiyan
schemes.brief: Comprehensive saturation of infrastructure & welfare in 63,000 tribal villages
schemes.briefHindi: 63,000 आदिवासी गांवों में बुनियादी ढांचे और कल्याणकारी योजनाओं की पूर्णता
schemes.benefit: Pucca road connectivity, clean tap water, mobile network towers, solar electricity, health wellness centres & livelihood support across 5 Crore tribal citizens
schemes.benefitHindi: 5 करोड़ आदिवासी नागरिकों के लिए पक्की सड़क, नल से जल, मोबाइल कनेक्टिविटी, सौर ऊर्जा व स्वास्थ्य केंद्र
schemes.description: Massive national initiative covering 63,000 tribal-majority villages with all essential government amenities.

schemes.name: Prime Minister's Research Fellowship (PMRF)
schemes.brief: ₹70,000-₹80,000/month fellowship + ₹2 Lakh/yr grant for direct Ph.D. at IITs/IISc
schemes.briefHindi: आईआईटी/आईआईएससी में डायरेक्ट पीएचडी हेतु ₹70,000-₹80,000/माह फेलोशिप + ₹2 लाख/वर्ष अनुदान
schemes.benefit: ₹70,000/month (Years 1-2), ₹75,000/month (Year 3), ₹80,000/month (Years 4-5) plus research grant of ₹2,00,000 per year
schemes.benefitHindi: प्रथम दो वर्ष ₹70,000/माह, तीसरे वर्ष ₹75,000/माह, चौथे-पांचवे वर्ष ₹80,000/माह एवं ₹2 लाख/वर्ष शोध अनुदान
documents: GATE Score Card / Top 5% Rank in Qualifying Degree
schemes.description: Prestigious fellowship designed for attracting top academic talent into doctoral research in Science and Technology.

schemes.name: Top Class Education Scheme for SC Students
schemes.nameHindi: अनुसूचित जाति के छात्रों के लिए श्रेष्ठ शिक्षा योजना
schemes.brief: Full tuition fees + living allowance for SC students admitted to IITs, IIMs, AIIMS, NLUs
schemes.briefHindi: आईआईटी, आईआईएम, एम्स और एनएलयू में प्रवेशित एससी छात्रों की पूरी फीस और जीवन निर्वाह भत्ता
schemes.benefit: Full non-refundable tuition fees reimbursed + ₹86,000 living expenses per year + ₹45,000 one-time computer grant + ₹5,000/yr book allowance
schemes.benefitHindi: पूरी ट्यूशन फीस + ₹86,000/वर्ष जीवन यापन भत्ता + ₹45,000 कंप्यूटर सहायता + ₹5,000/वर्ष पुस्तक भत्ता
schemes.description: Covers the entire financial cost of higher education for meritorious SC students enrolled in premier institutions.

schemes.name: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship
schemes.brief: ₹5,000 to ₹6,000 annual scholarship for meritorious minority schoolgirls (Class 9-12)
schemes.briefHindi: अल्पसंख्यक समुदाय की मेधावी छात्राओं (कक्षा 9-12) को ₹5,000 से ₹6,000 वार्षिक छात्रवृत्ति
schemes.benefit: ₹5,000/year for Class 9 & 10; ₹6,000/year for Class 11 & 12 to support schooling expenses of minority girls
schemes.benefitHindi: कक्षा 9 व 10 हेतु ₹5,000/वर्ष तथा कक्षा 11 व 12 हेतु ₹6,000/वर्ष सीधे बैंक खाते में
schemes.description: Financial assistance for meritorious minority girl students studying in Classes 9th to 12th.

schemes.name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls
schemes.brief: ₹50,000/year scholarship for female students admitted to technical degree or diploma courses
schemes.briefHindi: तकनीकी डिग्री या डिप्लोमा में प्रवेशित बालिकाओं को ₹50,000 प्रति वर्ष छात्रवृत्ति
schemes.benefit: ₹50,000 per annum for every year of study towards college fee payment, computer, books & equipment purchase (up to 4 years)
schemes.benefitHindi: कॉलेज फीस, कंप्यूटर व पाठ्य सामग्री हेतु ₹50,000 प्रति वर्ष (अधिकतम 4 वर्ष तक)
schemes.description: Provides financial aid to girl students pursuing technical education across all AICTE-approved institutions in India.

schemes.name: Working Women Hostel Scheme (Sakhi Niwas)
schemes.brief: Safe, subsidized urban accommodation with daycare creche for employed women
schemes.briefHindi: शहरी कामकाजी महिलाओं के लिए सुरक्षित, रियायती आवास और शिशु गृह सुविधा
schemes.benefit: Clean, secure and highly subsidized hostel living in metropolitan & tier-2/3 cities with daycare facilities for children up to 5 years
schemes.benefitHindi: महानगरों एवं छोटे शहरों में सुरक्षा व सीसीटीवी युक्त रियायती आवास एवं 5 वर्ष तक के बच्चों के लिए डे-केयर क्रेच
schemes.description: Provides safe, conveniently located accommodation for working women, single mothers, and job trainees living away from their hometowns.

schemes.name: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate (MSSC)
schemes.brief: Guaranteed 7.5% annual interest for 2-year deposit up to ₹2 Lakh for women/girls
schemes.briefHindi: महिलाओं व बालिकाओं के लिए 2 वर्ष की जमा पर 7.5% सुनिश्चित वार्षिक ब्याज (अधिकतम ₹2 लाख)
schemes.benefit: Fixed 7.5% annual interest compounded quarterly, partial withdrawal up to 40% allowed after 1 year, zero market risk backed by Govt of India
schemes.benefitHindi: 7.5% सुरक्षित वार्षिक ब्याज, 1 वर्ष बाद 40% तक निकासी की सुविधा, पूर्णतः सरकारी सुरक्षा
schemes.description: Government-backed high-yield small savings scheme exclusively for women and girl children.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana
schemes.brief: 40% to 60% subsidy for fish farming, biofloc, pond construction & boats
schemes.briefHindi: मछली पालन, बायोफ्लॉक, तालाब निर्माण और नावों के लिए 40% से 60% सब्सिडी
schemes.benefit: Government subsidy of 40% (General) and 60% (SC/ST/Women) on aquaculture projects up to ₹25 Lakh, including insulated vehicles and cold storages
schemes.benefitHindi: मछली पालन, आइस बॉक्स, वाहन व बायोफ्लॉक तालाब हेतु 40% (सामान्य) व 60% (महिला/एससी/एसटी) सरकारी सब्सिडी
schemes.description: Flagship program aimed at modernizing fisheries infrastructure, enhancing fish productivity and boosting fisherfolk income.

schemes.name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
schemes.brief: Up to 50% capital subsidy for greenhouses, orchards, cold storage & mushroom cultivation
schemes.briefHindi: पॉलीहाउस, फलदार बाग, कोल्ड स्टोरेज और मशरूम उत्पादन हेतु 50% तक पूंजीगत सब्सिडी
schemes.benefit: 50% grant assistance for polyhouses/greenhouses, high-density fruit orchards, drip irrigation setups and pack-houses up to ₹30 Lakh per unit
schemes.benefitHindi: पॉलीहाउस, फलदार बागवानी, मशरूम फार्म व पैक-हाउस स्थापित करने पर 50% तक वित्तीय अनुदान
schemes.description: Holistic development scheme covering fruits, vegetables, root crops, spices, and floriculture with generous infrastructure subsidies.

schemes.name: Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana (TB Nutrition Support)
schemes.brief: ₹500 to ₹1,000/month direct cash assistance for nutrition during TB treatment
schemes.briefHindi: टीबी उपचार के दौरान पोषण हेतु ₹500 से ₹1,000 प्रति माह प्रत्यक्ष नकद सहायता
schemes.benefit: Direct Bank Transfer of ₹500 to ₹1,000 per month directly into the patient's bank account for each month of DOTS tuberculosis treatment
schemes.benefitHindi: टीबी के सम्पूर्ण इलाज के दौरान पोषण आहार हेतु ₹500-₹1,000 प्रति माह सीधा बैंक खाते में
documents: TB Notification Number from DOTS Centre
schemes.description: Nutritional financial support program for all notified tuberculosis patients undergoing medical treatment in India.

schemes.name: PM-eBus Sewa Scheme
schemes.brief: 10,000 electric AC city buses across 169 tier-2/3 cities with affordable fares
schemes.briefHindi: 169 छोटे-बड़े शहरों में 10,000 वातानुकूलित इलेक्ट्रिक सिटी बसें किफायती किराए पर
schemes.benefit: Eco-friendly, zero-emission air-conditioned city transit with concessional fares for students, women, senior citizens and digital ticketing
schemes.benefitHindi: छात्रों, महिलाओं और वरिष्ठ नागरिकों हेतु रियायती पास के साथ आरामदायक वातानुकूलित इलेक्ट्रिक बस सेवा
documents: Aadhaar Card / Student ID for concessional bus passes
schemes.description: Deploys 10,000 green electric buses on public-private partnership models in cities lacking organized public transport.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana
schemes.brief: ₹25,000 phased cash assistance from birth to graduation for girl child in UP
schemes.briefHindi: बालिका के जन्म से लेकर स्नातक तक ₹25,000 की चरणबद्ध वित्तीय सहायता
schemes.benefit: Direct cash deposits across 6 developmental milestones: ₹5,000 at birth, ₹2,000 on vaccination, ₹3,000 at Class 1, ₹3,000 at Class 6, ₹5,000 at Class 9, ₹7,000 at Degree admission
schemes.benefitHindi: 6 चरणों में कुल ₹25,000: जन्म पर ₹5,000, टीकाकरण पर ₹2,000, कक्षा 1, 6 व 9 में प्रवेश पर और डिग्री/डिप्लोमा पर ₹7,000
schemes.description: Uttar Pradesh government's signature scheme to empower daughters through staggered monetary support till graduation.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Abhyudaya Yojana (Free Coaching)
schemes.brief: Free high-end offline coaching & digital tablets for UPSC, UPPSC, JEE, NEET in UP
schemes.briefHindi: आईएएस, पीसीएस, जेईई और नीट की निःशुल्क कोचिंग और मुफ्त डिजिटल टैबलेट
schemes.benefit: Free classroom coaching by IAS/IPS officers and subject mentors, library access, online test series, and free tablet distribution for meritorious students
schemes.benefitHindi: आईएएस/आईपीएस अधिकारियों व शीर्ष शिक्षकों द्वारा मुफ्त क्लासरूम कोचिंग, डिजिटल स्टडी मटेरियल व फ्री टैबलेट
schemes.description: Provides free competitive examination coaching to underprivileged aspirants across all 75 districts of Uttar Pradesh.

schemes.name: Swami Vivekanand Yuva Sashaktikaran (UP Free Smartphone)
schemes.nameHindi: स्वामी विवेकानन्द युवा सशक्तिकरण योजना (मुफ्त स्मार्टफोन)
schemes.department: Department of IT & Electronics, Uttar Pradesh
schemes.brief: Free 5G smartphones/tablets for final-year college & diploma students in UP
schemes.briefHindi: यूपी के उच्च शिक्षा, तकनीकी एवं डिप्लोमा विद्यार्थियों को मुफ्त 5G स्मार्टफोन/टैबलेट
schemes.benefit: Completely free branded 5G smartphone/tablet preloaded with educational content, competitive exam materials and job portal apps (zero cost)
schemes.benefitHindi: निःशुल्क ब्रांडेड स्मार्टफोन/टैबलेट — शैक्षिक ऐप्स व रोजगार पोर्टल की सुविधाओं से युक्त
schemes.description: Distributes free digital devices to millions of university, polytechnic, and ITI students to bridge the digital divide.

schemes.name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY)
schemes.nameHindi: महात्मा ज्योतिराव फुले जन आरोग्य योजना (महाराष्ट्र)
schemes.brief: ₹5 Lakh completely cashless medical treatment per family across 1,000+ surgeries in MH
schemes.briefHindi: महाराष्ट्र के सभी परिवारों को ₹5 लाख तक का पूर्णतः कैशलेस अस्पताल उपचार
schemes.benefit: Universal health cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year covering 1,356 secondary and tertiary hospital procedures in empanelled private and govt hospitals
schemes.benefitHindi: 1,356 प्रकार की जटिल बीमारियों व ऑपरेशनों के लिए प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख का कैशलेस उपचार
apply_mode: Hospital Arogyamitra Counter at any Network Hospital
schemes.description: Comprehensive universal health protection scheme of the Government of Maharashtra guaranteeing cashless treatment.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
schemes.brief: ₹1,500 monthly direct bank transfer for women aged 21-65 in Maharashtra
schemes.briefHindi: महाराष्ट्र की 21-65 वर्ष की पात्र महिलाओं को ₹1,500 प्रति माह सीधा बैंक खाते में
schemes.benefit: Direct Bank Transfer of ₹1,500 every month (₹18,000 per year) directly to the Aadhaar-linked bank accounts of women with family income under ₹2.5 Lakh
schemes.benefitHindi: हर महीने ₹1,500 (सालाना ₹18,000) सीधा बैंक खाते में महिलाओं के आर्थिक स्वावलंबन हेतु
schemes.description: Direct financial independence initiative providing monthly sustenance assistance to married, widowed, and destitute women.

schemes.name: Ramai Awas Yojana (Gharkul Scheme)
schemes.brief: ₹1.30 Lakh to ₹2.50 Lakh financial subsidy for pucca house to SC/Neo-Buddhist families
schemes.briefHindi: अनुसूचित जाति व नवबौद्ध परिवारों को पक्का मकान बनाने हेतु ₹1.30 लाख से ₹2.50 लाख अनुदान
schemes.benefit: Financial grant of ₹1.30 Lakh (rural) to ₹2.50 Lakh (urban/municipal) in multiple construction stages for permanent house construction
schemes.benefitHindi: ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में ₹1.30 लाख तथा नगर पालिका/महानगर में ₹2.50 लाख तक पक्का घर अनुदान
schemes.description: Dedicated housing scheme for shelterless Scheduled Caste and Neo-Buddhist families living in rural and urban areas of Maharashtra.

schemes.name: Palanhar Yojana (Child Foster Assistance)
schemes.brief: ₹1,500 to ₹2,500/month stipend for foster care & schooling of orphan/destitute children in RJ
schemes.briefHindi: अनाथ व निराश्रित बच्चों के पालन-पोषण व शिक्षा हेतु ₹1,500 से ₹2,500 प्रति माह पेंशन
schemes.benefit: Monthly assistance: ₹1,500/month for children aged 0-6 years and ₹2,500/month for school-going children aged 6-18 years + ₹2,000 annual cloth/shoe allowance
schemes.description: Pioneering institutional-free foster child protection scheme ensuring orphans and children of disabled/widow parents receive family care and schooling.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Anuprati Coaching Yojana
schemes.brief: 100% free coaching in top institutes + ₹40,000/yr hostel stipend for UPSC, NEET, CLAT in RJ
schemes.briefHindi: आईएएस, आरएएस, नीट, क्लैट की नामी कोचिंग संस्थानों में 100% मुफ्त तैयारी + ₹40,000/वर्ष छात्रावास भत्ता
schemes.benefit: Full fees paid directly to premier coaching institutes for UPSC, RAS, IIT-JEE, NEET, CLAT, CA, REET + ₹40,000 annual stipend for outstation students
schemes.benefitHindi: शीर्ष कोचिंग संस्थानों की सम्पूर्ण फीस राज्य सरकार द्वारा देय + बाहरी छात्रों को ₹40,000 प्रति वर्ष भोजन/आवास भत्ता
schemes.description: Merit-based competitive exam coaching program in Rajasthan covering 30,000 underprivileged students annually.

schemes.name: Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar)
schemes.department: Social Welfare & Women Empowerment, Tamil Nadu
schemes.brief: ₹1,000/month directly to girl students of govt schools pursuing higher education in TN
schemes.briefHindi: सरकारी स्कूल से पढ़कर कॉलेज जाने वाली छात्राओं को ₹1,000 प्रति माह उच्च शिक्षा प्रोत्साहन
schemes.benefit: Direct Bank Transfer of ₹1,000 every single month until graduation / diploma / ITI completion with zero breaks
schemes.benefitHindi: डिग्री, डिप्लोमा या इंजीनियरिंग की पूरी अवधि के दौरान ₹1,000 प्रति माह सीधा बैंक खाते में
schemes.description: Drastically increases female college enrollment across Tamil Nadu by replacing marriage dowry culture with monthly college education allowances.

schemes.name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai (Basic Income for Women)
schemes.nameHindi: कलैग्नार महिला अधिकार योजना (तमिलनाडु बुनियादी आय)
schemes.brief: ₹1,000/month universal basic income for 1.15 Crore women heads of families in TN
schemes.briefHindi: तमिलनाडु की 1.15 करोड़ महिला मुखियाओं को ₹1,000 प्रति माह सुनिश्चित बुनियादी आय
schemes.benefit: Guaranteed monthly cash transfer of ₹1,000 on the 15th of every calendar month directly to women bank accounts across 1.15 Crore households
schemes.benefitHindi: हर महीने की 15 तारीख को ₹1,000 सीधा बैंक खाते में महिलाओं के श्रम के सम्मान में
schemes.description: One of the world's largest basic income programs recognizing the uncompensated domestic labour of 1.15 Crore women.

schemes.name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)
schemes.brief: ₹5 Lakh cashless health cover per family per year in 1,600+ network hospitals in TN
schemes.briefHindi: तमिलनाडु में प्रति परिवार ₹5 लाख का कैशलेस उपचार (1,600+ निजी व सरकारी अस्पताल)
schemes.benefit: Cashless coverage for 1,513 medical & surgical treatments, 52 diagnostic tests, and 8 high-end complex procedures up to ₹5 Lakh/family/year
schemes.benefitHindi: 1,513 प्रकार की सर्जरी, जांच व कैंसर/हार्ट इलाज हेतु प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख का कैशलेस बीमा
schemes.description: Tamil Nadu's flagship comprehensive health insurance program partnering with over 1,600 elite hospitals.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana
schemes.brief: ₹54,100 cumulative grant from birth till graduation for every girl in Bihar
schemes.briefHindi: बिहार की बालिकाओं को जन्म से स्नातक डिग्री तक कुल ₹54,100 की प्रोत्साहन राशि
schemes.benefit: Staggered cash rewards: ₹2,000 at birth, ₹1,000 at 1 yr, ₹2,000 at 2 yr, ₹10,000 on passing Class 10 (1st div), ₹25,000 on Class 12, and ₹50,000 on completing Graduation
schemes.benefitHindi: जन्म पर ₹2,000, टीकाकरण पर ₹3,000, मैट्रिक पर ₹10,000, इंटरमीडिएट पर ₹25,000 और स्नातक उत्तीर्ण करने पर ₹50,000 एकमुश्त
schemes.description: Bihar's universal girl empowerment scheme providing cumulative incentives from infancy through college graduation.

schemes.name: Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme (MNSSBY)
schemes.brief: Collateral-free education loan up to ₹4 Lakh at 1% (women/PwD) & 4% interest in Bihar
schemes.briefHindi: उच्च शिक्षा हेतु ₹4 लाख तक का बिना गारंटी लोन — केवल 1% से 4% साधारण ब्याज पर
schemes.benefit: Guaranteed educational loan up to ₹4,00,000 covering tuition, hostel, laptop and books for 40+ professional courses; repayment begins 1 year after course completion
schemes.benefitHindi: बीटेक, एमबीबीएस, बीएससी, डिप्लोमा हेतु ₹4 लाख तक ऋण — पढ़ाई खत्म होने के 1 साल बाद आसान किस्तों में वापसी
schemes.description: Part of Bihar's 7 Nischay initiative guaranteeing credit to youth to pursue higher education without mortgage or guarantor.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Balak / Balika Cycle Yojana
schemes.brief: ₹3,000 cash grant to every Class 9 student in Bihar to purchase a new bicycle
schemes.briefHindi: बिहार के कक्षा 9वीं में नामांकित सभी छात्र-छात्राओं को साइकिल खरीदने हेतु ₹3,000 नकद
schemes.benefit: Direct Bank Transfer of ₹3,000 into the student's account upon reaching Class 9 in any government secondary school to prevent dropouts caused by long distance commutes
schemes.benefitHindi: कक्षा 9वीं के हर छात्र-छात्रा को स्कूल आने-जाने हेतु नई साइकिल खरीदने के लिए ₹3,000 की राशि
schemes.description: Globally acclaimed initiative that transformed girl student retention in rural secondary schools throughout Bihar.

schemes.name: Swasthya Sathi Scheme
schemes.brief: ₹5 Lakh cashless health cover per family in name of the female head of family in WB
schemes.briefHindi: महिला मुखिया के नाम पर प्रति परिवार ₹5 लाख का संपूर्ण कैशलेस स्वास्थ्य बीमा
schemes.benefit: Smart health card issued exclusively in the name of the eldest woman of the household offering ₹5 Lakh per annum cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalisation
schemes.benefitHindi: घर की सबसे वरिष्ठ महिला के नाम पर जारी स्मार्ट कार्ड से 2,000 से अधिक अस्पतालों में ₹5 लाख तक का कैशलेस इलाज
schemes.description: Pioneering paperless health coverage scheme empowering women as the primary cardholder for the entire family.

schemes.name: Lakshmir Bhandar Scheme
schemes.brief: ₹1,000/mo (General) & ₹1,200/mo (SC/ST) assured monthly income for adult women in WB
schemes.briefHindi: सामान्य महिलाओं को ₹1,000/माह तथा एससी/एसटी महिलाओं को ₹1,200/माह प्रत्यक्ष सहायता
schemes.benefit: Direct Bank Transfer of ₹1,000/month for General category women and ₹1,200/month for SC/ST women aged 25-60 years directly into their bank accounts
schemes.benefitHindi: 25-60 वर्ष की सामान्य महिलाओं को ₹1,000/माह एवं अनुसूचित जाति/जनजाति की महिलाओं को ₹1,200/माह
schemes.description: Flagship social security program extending monthly financial dignity to over 2 Crore women across West Bengal.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana
schemes.brief: ₹1,250 monthly direct cash transfer for women aged 21-60 in Madhya Pradesh
schemes.briefHindi: मध्य प्रदेश की 21-60 वर्ष की महिलाओं को ₹1,250 प्रति माह सीधा बैंक खाते में
schemes.benefit: Guaranteed monthly cash transfer of ₹1,250 (₹15,000 annually) transferred on the 10th of every month into Aadhaar-linked DBT bank accounts
schemes.benefitHindi: हर महीने की 10 तारीख को ₹1,250 सीधा बैंक खाते में महिलाओं के स्वास्थ्य व पोषण सुधार हेतु
documents: Aadhaar-Linked Bank Account with DBT Active
schemes.description: Direct welfare transfer program providing vital economic autonomy to more than 1.25 Crore women in Madhya Pradesh.

schemes.name: Mukhya Mantri Jan Kalyan (Sambal 2.0)
schemes.nameHindi: मुख्यमंत्री जन कल्याण (संबल 2.0 योजना - मध्य प्रदेश)
schemes.brief: Complete social security: maternity aid, free electricity, accidental cover up to ₹4 Lakh in MP
schemes.briefHindi: असंगठित श्रमिकों को ₹4 लाख दुर्घटना सहायता, ₹16,000 प्रसूति सहायता और बिजली माफी
schemes.benefit: ₹4,00,000 for accidental death, ₹2,00,000 for natural death, ₹16,000 maternity assistance, ₹5,000 funeral assistance, and free college tuition for children of unorganized workers
schemes.benefitHindi: दुर्घटना मृत्यु पर ₹4 लाख, सामान्य मृत्यु पर ₹2 लाख, प्रसूति पर ₹16,000 व बच्चों की उच्च शिक्षा की पूरी फीस माफी
schemes.description: Cradle-to-grave social security umbrella for millions of unorganized workers throughout Madhya Pradesh.

schemes.name: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme
schemes.brief: ₹2,000 monthly cash assistance to woman head of household in Karnataka
schemes.briefHindi: कर्नाटक में परिवार की महिला मुखिया को ₹2,000 प्रति माह प्रत्यक्ष वित्तीय सहायता
schemes.benefit: Direct Bank Transfer of ₹2,000 per month (₹24,000 annually) directly deposited into the woman head of household's bank account for BPL, APL and Antyodaya cardholders
schemes.benefitHindi: हर महीने ₹2,000 (सालाना ₹24,000) महिला मुखिया के बैंक खाते में सीधा अंतरण
apply_mode: Karnataka One / Bangalore One / Grama One Centers
schemes.description: One of Karnataka's 5 Guarantees providing unconditional financial support to over 1.2 Crore household matriarchs.

schemes.name: Yuva Nidhi Scheme (Unemployment Allowance)
schemes.brief: ₹3,000/mo for unemployed graduates & ₹1,500/mo for diploma holders in Karnataka
schemes.briefHindi: कर्नाटक के बेरोजगार स्नातकों को ₹3,000/माह तथा डिप्लोमा धारकों को ₹1,500/माह भत्ता
schemes.benefit: Financial assistance of ₹3,000/month for degree holders and ₹1,500/month for diploma holders for up to 2 years while seeking employment or during skill training
schemes.benefitHindi: नौकरी मिलने या 2 वर्ष की अवधि तक स्नातकों को ₹3,000/माह एवं डिप्लोमा धारकों को ₹1,500/माह बेरोजगारी भत्ता
schemes.description: Supports educated youth in Karnataka during their job search with a dignified living allowance and free skill development.

schemes.name: Shakti Scheme (Free Bus Travel for Women)
schemes.nameHindi: शक्ति योजना (महिलाओं के लिए मुफ्त बस यात्रा - कर्नाटक)
schemes.brief: 100% free travel in ordinary state buses across all of Karnataka for women & transgenders
schemes.briefHindi: कर्नाटक में महिलाओं व उभयलिंगियों के लिए राज्य परिवहन निगम की बसों में 100% मुफ्त यात्रा
schemes.benefit: Free travel across all KSRTC, BMTC, NWKRTC, and KKRTC non-luxury state buses anywhere within Karnataka borders without ticketing charges
schemes.benefitHindi: केएसआरटीसी व बीएमटीसी की साधारण व एक्सप्रेस बसों में शून्य किराए पर पूरे कर्नाटक में असीमित यात्रा
documents: Aadhaar Card / Voter ID / Govt ID proving Karnataka Domicile
schemes.description: Revolutionized female workforce participation in Karnataka by eliminating public commuting expenses entirely.

schemes.name: LIFE Mission Housing Scheme
schemes.brief: ₹4 Lakh subsidy for homeless families + modern apartment complexes in Kerala
schemes.briefHindi: केरल में बेघर परिवारों को पक्के घर हेतु ₹4 लाख अनुदान अथवा आधुनिक फ्लैट
schemes.benefit: Grant of ₹4,00,000 in 4 instalments for construction of a 400+ sq.ft pucca house, or free allotment of a modern housing flat with community hall for landless families
schemes.benefitHindi: घर बनाने हेतु ₹4 लाख का 4 किस्तों में अनुदान, अथवा भूमिहीन परिवारों को बहुमंजिला आवासीय कॉम्प्लेक्स में मुफ्त फ्लैट
schemes.description: Kerala's flagship mission ensuring safe, permanent, and dignifying shelter for every homeless family in the state.

schemes.name: Karunya Arogya Suraksha Padhathi (KASP)
schemes.nameHindi: कारुण्या आरोग्य सुरक्षा पद्धति (केरल स्वास्थ्य योजना)
schemes.brief: ₹5 Lakh per family per year cashless treatment + Karunya benevolent dialysis assistance
schemes.briefHindi: केरल में प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख का कैशलेस उपचार + डायलिसिस व कैंसर पर विशेष सहायता
schemes.benefit: Cashless secondary and tertiary healthcare up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year in 700+ empanelled hospitals, plus special relief for kidney dialysis, haemophilia and oncology
schemes.benefitHindi: 700+ अस्पतालों में ₹5 लाख तक का कैशलेस इलाज तथा डायलिसिस, कैंसर व हीमोफीलिया के मरीजों को विशेष वित्तीय सुरक्षा
apply_mode: KASP Kiosks in Govt Medical Colleges & Taluk Hospitals
schemes.description: Comprehensive public health financing scheme integrating AB-PMJAY with state Karunya benevolent medical grants.

schemes.name: Kisan Suryodaya Yojana
schemes.brief: Guaranteed 3-phase daytime electricity (5 AM - 9 PM) for farm irrigation across Gujarat
schemes.briefHindi: गुजरात के किसानों को सिंचाई हेतु दिन के समय (सुबह 5 से रात 9) 3-फेज निर्बाध बिजली
schemes.benefit: Guaranteed daytime high-power electricity supply for agricultural borewells and pump sets eliminating dangerous night-time irrigation work in snake/wild animal infested fields
schemes.benefitHindi: किसानों को रात के अंधेरे व जहरीले जीवों के भय से मुक्ति — दिन के उजाले में 8 घंटे सुनिश्चित 3-फेज कृषि बिजली
apply_mode: UGVCL / DGVCL / MGVCL / PGVCL Electricity Substation
schemes.description: Transformative energy initiative delivering day-time electricity for agricultural irrigation across 4,000+ Gujarat villages.

schemes.name: Manav Garima Yojana
schemes.brief: Free professional toolkits worth up to ₹25,000 for 28 self-employment vocations in Gujarat
schemes.briefHindi: गुजरात के 28 प्रकार के कारीगरों को ₹25,000 तक के आधुनिक टूलकिट 100% मुफ्त
schemes.benefit: 100% free distribution of branded modern toolkits (tailoring machines, plumbing kits, carpentry tools, beauty parlour kits, electrical testing equipment) without loans or repayment
schemes.benefitHindi: दर्जी मशीन, प्लंबर किट, ब्यूटी पार्लर उपकरण, बढ़ई व इलेक्ट्रीशियन किट पूर्णतः मुफ्त वितरण
documents: Annual Income Certificate (< ₹1.5L in rural / ₹1.5L in urban)
schemes.description: Empowers underprivileged micro-entrepreneurs and artisans with free high-grade occupational tools to establish self-reliant livelihoods.

schemes.name: Rythu Bandhu (Farmer Investment Support)
schemes.nameHindi: रायथू बंधु योजना (तेलंगाना किसान निवेश सहायता)
schemes.brief: ₹10,000 per acre per year direct cash for agricultural seeds & fertilizers in Telangana
schemes.briefHindi: तेलंगाना में प्रति एकड़ प्रति वर्ष ₹10,000 बीज-खाद निवेश सहायता (सीधा बैंक खाते में)
schemes.benefit: Direct Bank Transfer of ₹5,000/acre each for Kharif and Rabi seasons (total ₹10,000/acre/year) with no upper limit on acreage for all landowning farmers
schemes.benefitHindi: खरीफ व रबी दोनों फसलों के लिए ₹5,000-₹5,000 प्रति एकड़ सीधा बैंक खाते में बिना किसी बिचौलिए के
schemes.description: The pioneer direct input support model in India that inspired national welfare schemes like PM-KISAN.

schemes.name: Kalyana Lakshmi & Shaadi Mubarak
schemes.brief: ₹1,00,116 one-time marriage assistance for brides from underprivileged families in TS
schemes.briefHindi: तेलंगाना में गरीब परिवारों की कन्याओं के विवाह हेतु ₹1,00,116 की एकमुश्त आर्थिक सहायता
schemes.benefit: One-time financial grant of ₹1,00,116 directly credited into the unmarried bride's mother's bank account before marriage ceremony to eradicate debt traps
schemes.benefitHindi: विवाह से पूर्व कन्या की माता के बैंक खाते में ₹1,00,116 की सीधी राशि अंतरित
documents: Age Proof (18+ for bride, 21+ for groom)
schemes.description: Massive social relief program protecting low-income families from predatory moneylenders at the time of daughter's marriage.

schemes.name: Dr. YSR Aarogyasri Health Scheme
schemes.nameHindi: डॉ वाईएसआर आरोग्यश्री स्वास्थ्य योजना (आंध्र प्रदेश)
schemes.department: Health, Medical & Family Welfare, Andhra Pradesh
schemes.brief: ₹25 Lakh cashless healthcare for 3,257 procedures in top AP, Hyderabad & Chennai hospitals
schemes.briefHindi: आंध्र प्रदेश, हैदराबाद व चेन्नई के अस्पतालों में 3,257 प्रक्रियाओं हेतु ₹25 लाख का कैशलेस इलाज
schemes.benefit: Universal health security covering 3,257 treatments completely free up to ₹25 Lakh per family per year, plus ₹225/day post-operative recuperative allowance (Aarogya Aasara)
schemes.benefitHindi: प्रति परिवार ₹25 लाख का निःशुल्क कैशलेस अस्पताल इलाज + अस्पताल से छुट्टी के बाद ₹225/दिन विश्राम भत्ता
apply_mode: Aarogyamitra Desk at any Network Hospital
schemes.description: Andhra Pradesh's extensive medical safety net extending cashless care for over 3,200 procedures across three southern states.

schemes.name: Biju Swasthya Kalyan Yojana (BSKY)
schemes.brief: ₹5 Lakh for family and ₹10 Lakh for women members cashless treatment in 800+ hospitals in OD
schemes.briefHindi: परिवार हेतु ₹5 लाख एवं महिला सदस्यों हेतु ₹10 लाख का कैशलेस स्वास्थ्य उपचार
schemes.benefit: Cashless secondary and tertiary care up to ₹5,00,000 per family and an enhanced ₹10,00,000 for women members per year across 800+ premier empanelled hospitals in India
schemes.benefitHindi: प्रति परिवार ₹5 लाख तथा महिलाओं के लिए ₹10 लाख तक का पूर्णतः कैशलेस अस्पताल इलाज
documents: BSKY Nabin Card / NFSA Ration Card
schemes.description: Odisha's state-funded universal health model prioritizing female healthcare with double coverage limits.

schemes.name: Punjab Aashirwad Scheme (Shagun Scheme)
schemes.brief: ₹51,000 direct grant for marriage of daughters from SC, BC & BPL families in Punjab
schemes.briefHindi: पंजाब में अनुसूचित जाति, पिछड़ा वर्ग व बीपीएल परिवारों की कन्याओं के विवाह पर ₹51,000 शगुन
schemes.benefit: Direct Bank Transfer of ₹51,000 credited directly into the bank account of the bride or her parents before or on the wedding day
schemes.benefitHindi: विवाह के समय ₹51,000 की एकमुश्त वित्तीय सहायता सीधे कन्या अथवा माता-पिता के बैंक खाते में
schemes.description: Financial assistance provided by the Government of Punjab to underprivileged families for the wedding of their daughters.

schemes.name: Haryana HAPPY Scheme (Free Roadways Bus Travel)
schemes.nameHindi: हरियाणा हैप्पी योजना (मुफ्त रोडवेज बस यात्रा)
schemes.brief: 1,000 km free annual bus travel in Haryana Roadways for Antyodaya families (income < ₹1L)
schemes.briefHindi: ₹1 लाख से कम आय वाले परिवारों को हरियाणा रोडवेज बसों में हर साल 1,000 किमी मुफ्त यात्रा
schemes.benefit: Smart mobility card loaded with 1,000 km of 100% free bus travel every year on all Haryana Roadways ordinary and semi-deluxe routes
schemes.benefitHindi: स्मार्ट मोबिलिटी कार्ड द्वारा परिवार के प्रत्येक सदस्य को सालाना 1,000 किमी तक मुफ्त रोडवेज बस सफर
schemes.description: Haryana Antyodaya Parivar Parivahan Yojana providing 1,000 km free travel to economically weaker citizens.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana
schemes.brief: Guaranteed 7.4% monthly pension for 10 years managed through LIC for seniors
schemes.briefHindi: एलआईसी द्वारा संचालित वरिष्ठ नागरिकों के लिए 10 वर्ष तक सुनिश्चित 7.4% मासिक पेंशन
schemes.benefit: Regular monthly pension of up to ₹9,250 per month for 10 years on investment up to ₹15 Lakh, with full return of purchase price at maturity
schemes.benefitHindi: 10 वर्षों के लिए ₹9,250/माह तक सुनिश्चित पेंशन तथा परिपक्वता पर पूरी जमा राशि वापस
schemes.description: Pension scheme for seniors operated exclusively through the Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC).

schemes.name: National Beekeeping & Honey Mission (Sweet Revolution)
schemes.nameHindi: राष्ट्रीय मधुमक्खी पालन और शहद मिशन
schemes.brief: Up to 80% subsidy on beehives, colonies and honey extraction equipment
schemes.briefHindi: मधुमक्खी बक्से, कालोनियों और शहद प्रसंस्करण उपकरणों पर 80% तक सब्सिडी
schemes.benefit: Financial assistance up to 80% on cost of 50 bee boxes & colonies (cost ₹2 Lakh, subsidy ₹1.60 Lakh) + training and guaranteed buyback support
schemes.benefitHindi: 50 मधुमक्खी बक्सों व कालोनियों पर 80% (₹1.60 लाख) तक की भारी सब्सिडी
schemes.description: Promotes scientific beekeeping to augment farmers' income and enhance crop pollination and yield.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Udyami Yojana (Bihar)
schemes.brief: ₹10 Lakh financial package (50% grant + 50% interest-free loan) to set up small industry in Bihar
schemes.briefHindi: बिहार में नया उद्योग शुरू करने हेतु ₹10 लाख — ₹5 लाख अनुदान (माफ) + ₹5 लाख ब्याज मुक्त ऋण
schemes.benefit: Total ₹10,00,000 package: ₹5 Lakh 100% non-repayable grant + ₹5 Lakh interest-free loan (0% for SC/ST/Women, 1% for BC/EBC/Youth) repayable in 84 easy installments
schemes.benefitHindi: ₹5 लाख की पूरी सरकारी माफी (सब्सिडी) और शेष ₹5 लाख 84 आसान किस्तों में 0% से 1% साधारण ब्याज पर
schemes.description: Bihar's landmark enterprise creation scheme creating tens of thousands of micro-factories and processing units.

schemes.name: Rupashree Prakalpa (West Bengal)
schemes.brief: ₹25,000 one-time cash grant for marriage of adult daughters from low-income families in WB
schemes.briefHindi: पश्चिम बंगाल में आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर परिवारों की बेटियों के विवाह हेतु ₹25,000 का अनुदान
schemes.benefit: One-time Direct Bank Transfer of ₹25,000 directly credited into the prospective bride's bank account before her wedding date to mitigate dowry pressures
schemes.benefitHindi: विवाह से पूर्व कन्या के स्वयं के बैंक खाते में ₹25,000 की सीधी नकद सहायता
documents: Age Proof (18+ for bride, 21+ for groom)
schemes.description: Financial grant scheme for adult daughters of low-income families in West Bengal on their wedding day.

schemes.name: Mukhyamantri Seekho Kamao Yojana (MMSKY)
schemes.department: Technical Education & Skill Development, Madhya Pradesh
schemes.brief: ₹8,000 to ₹10,000/month stipend while learning industry skills in top MP companies
schemes.briefHindi: मध्य प्रदेश में कंपनियों में कौशल सीखते हुए ₹8,000 से ₹10,000 प्रति माह वजीफा
