schemes.benefit: On-the-job technical training across 703 courses with direct monthly DBT stipend: ₹8,000/mo (Class 12), ₹8,500/mo (ITI), ₹9,000/mo (Diploma) and ₹10,000/mo (Degree)
schemes.description: Earn-while-you-learn employment training program with direct bank payments across private industries in MP.

schemes.name: Vahli Dikri Yojana (Dear Daughter Scheme)
schemes.brief: ₹1,10,000 cumulative grant from school entry to adulthood for girl child in Gujarat
schemes.briefHindi: गुजरात की बालिकाओं को कक्षा 1 से 18 वर्ष की आयु तक कुल ₹1,10,000 की वित्तीय सहायता
schemes.benefit: ₹4,000 at admission to Class 1, ₹6,000 at Class 9 admission, and ₹1,00,000 on turning 18 for higher education or marriage (applicable for first 2 girls of family)
schemes.benefitHindi: कक्षा 1 में ₹4,000, 9वीं में ₹6,000 और 18 वर्ष पूर्ण होने पर उच्च शिक्षा या विवाह हेतु ₹1 लाख
schemes.description: Incentivizes girl child survival and education in Gujarat with substantial milestone-based savings grants.

schemes.name: Dalit Bandhu Scheme (Telangana)
schemes.brief: ₹10 Lakh 100% direct grant (no loan, no repayment) for SC families to start businesses in TS
schemes.briefHindi: दलित परिवारों को उद्यम शुरू करने हेतु ₹10 लाख का 100% अनुदान (बिना बैंक ऋण व बिना वापसी)
schemes.benefit: Direct financial grant of ₹10,00,000 per eligible Scheduled Caste family deposited into a dedicated bank account for starting any enterprise, transport, retail or manufacturing business
schemes.benefitHindi: प्रति एससी परिवार ₹10 लाख की एकमुश्त अनुदान राशि — बिना किसी बैंक गारंटी या पुनर्भुगतान के
schemes.description: Groundbreaking financial empowerment scheme granting ₹10 Lakh outright capital to Scheduled Caste families to become business owners.

schemes.name: YSR Cheyutha Scheme (Andhra Pradesh)
schemes.brief: ₹75,000 over 4 years (₹18,750/year) for women aged 45-60 from SC, ST, BC, Minorities in AP
schemes.briefHindi: एससी, एसटी, बीसी और अल्पसंख्यक वर्ग की 45-60 वर्ष की महिलाओं को 4 साल में ₹75,000
schemes.benefit: Direct Bank Transfer of ₹18,750 per year for 4 continuous years (total ₹75,000) coupled with technical support from ITC, Amul, P&G for sustainable livelihood businesses
schemes.benefitHindi: सालाना ₹18,750 (4 साल में ₹75,000) सीधा बैंक खाते में अमूल/आईटीसी से किराना व डेयरी व्यापार हेतु
schemes.description: Financial and entrepreneurial assistance for middle-aged women belonging to marginalized social categories.

schemes.name: Snehapoorvam Scheme (Kerala)
schemes.brief: ₹300 to ₹1,000/month scholarship for children who lost father/mother and live with relatives
schemes.briefHindi: माता-पिता को खो चुके और रिश्तेदारों के साथ रह रहे बच्चों को ₹300 से ₹1,000/माह छात्रवृत्ति
schemes.benefit: Monthly financial aid from Class 1 through degree: ₹300/mo (Class 1-5), ₹500/mo (Class 6-10), ₹750/mo (Class 11-12) and ₹1,000/mo (Degree/Professional) to ensure children never abandon studies
schemes.benefitHindi: कक्षा 1 से कॉलेज तक ₹300 से ₹1,000 प्रति माह नियमित छात्रवृत्ति सीधे बैंक खाते में
schemes.description: Compassionate welfare safety net of Kerala Social Security Mission preventing destitute orphans from falling out of formal schooling.

schemes.name: SMILE Scheme (Support for Marginalized Individuals)
schemes.nameHindi: स्माइल योजना (हाशिए पर रहने वाले व्यक्तियों की आजीविका सहायता)
schemes.brief: Rehabilitation, skill training, and medical cover for transgender persons and destitute
schemes.briefHindi: किन्नर समुदाय व भिक्षावृत्ति में संलग्न व्यक्तियों का पुनर्वास एवं निःशुल्क कौशल प्रशिक्षण
schemes.benefit: Skill development training with ₹1,000/month stipend, composite healthcare cover under PM-JAY, and micro-enterprise loans up to ₹5 Lakh
schemes.benefitHindi: मुफ्त कौशल प्रशिक्षण + ₹1,000/माह वजीफा तथा ₹5 लाख तक का रियायती ऋण
schemes.description: Umbrella scheme for comprehensive rehabilitation and livelihood assistance for marginalized individuals.

schemes.name: NAMASTE Scheme (National Sanitation Workers Mission)
schemes.nameHindi: नमस्ते योजना (राष्ट्रीय सफाई कर्मचारी आजीविका मिशन)
schemes.brief: Up to ₹5 Lakh capital subsidy for sanitation workers to buy mechanized cleaning equipment
schemes.briefHindi: सफाई कर्मचारियों को आधुनिक सीवर सफाई मशीन खरीदने हेतु ₹5 लाख तक की पूंजीगत सब्सिडी
schemes.benefit: Capital subsidy up to 50% (max ₹5 Lakh) for buying mechanized cleaning vehicles, free PPE safety kits, and health insurance under PM-JAY
schemes.benefitHindi: सफाई मशीन/वाहन खरीदने पर 50% तक (अधिकतम ₹5 लाख) सरकारी सब्सिडी व आयुष्मान सुरक्षा
schemes.description: Ensures zero human entry into sewers by providing mechanized cleaning equipment with generous subsidies.

schemes.name: PM POSHAN Shakti Nirman (Hot Cooked Meals)
schemes.nameHindi: पीएम पोषण शक्ति निर्माण योजना (गर्म पौष्टिक भोजन)
schemes.brief: 100% free daily hot cooked nutritious meals for all students from Balvatika to Class 8
schemes.briefHindi: बालवाटिका से कक्षा 8 तक के सभी विद्यार्थियों को 100% मुफ्त गर्म पौष्टिक दोपहर का भोजन
schemes.benefit: Free wholesome hot meals providing 450-700 calories and 12-20g protein daily on every school working day for 12 Crore school children
schemes.benefitHindi: कक्षा 1 से 8 तक के प्रत्येक विद्यार्थी को स्कूल में प्रतिदिन मुफ्त गर्म व पौष्टिक भोजन
apply_mode: Direct enrollment in any Government or Government-Aided School
schemes.description: National school feeding program enhancing enrollment, attendance, and nutritional status of primary students.

schemes.name: National Livestock Mission (NLM)
schemes.brief: 50% capital subsidy up to ₹50 Lakh for goat, sheep, poultry and piggery farms
schemes.briefHindi: बकरी, भेड़, मुर्गी और सुअर पालन फार्म स्थापित करने पर 50% तक (₹50 लाख तक) सब्सिडी
schemes.benefit: Direct 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹50 Lakh for poultry, ₹50 Lakh for sheep/goat breeding farms, and ₹25 Lakh for fodder seed processing)
schemes.benefitHindi: पशुपालन फार्म और हैचरी शुरू करने पर लागत का 50% (अधिकतम ₹50 लाख) सीधा बैंक अनुदान
schemes.description: Financial assistance and capital subsidies for sustainable development of poultry, sheep, goat, and piggery entrepreneurship.

schemes.name: Dairy Entrepreneurship Development Scheme (DEDS)
schemes.brief: 25% to 33.33% back-ended capital subsidy via NABARD for dairy farm units
schemes.briefHindi: नाबार्ड के माध्यम से 2 से 10 दुधारू पशुओं की डेयरी खोलने पर 25% से 33% बैक-एंडेड सब्सिडी
schemes.benefit: 25% capital subsidy (General) up to ₹1.25 Lakh and 33.33% subsidy (SC/ST) up to ₹1.67 Lakh for setting up small modern dairy farms (up to 10 animals)
schemes.benefitHindi: दुधारू पशु, मिल्किंग मशीन व गोबर गैस हेतु 25% (सामान्य) व 33.33% (एससी/एसटी) नाबार्ड सब्सिडी
schemes.description: Promotes setting up of modern dairy farms for clean milk production with back-ended capital subsidy from NABARD.

schemes.name: Prime Minister Development Initiative for North East (PM-DevINE)
schemes.department: Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region
schemes.brief: 100% central funding for infrastructure and livelihood empowerment in North East states
schemes.briefHindi: पूर्वोत्तर भारत के 8 राज्यों में आजीविका, स्वास्थ्य व युवा रोजगार हेतु 100% केंद्रीय अनुदान
schemes.benefit: Dedicated infrastructure projects, bamboo processing clusters, youth incubation, and rural entrepreneurship programs across Assam, Meghalaya, Manipur, Mizoram, Nagaland, Tripura, Arunachal & Sikkim
schemes.benefitHindi: पूर्वोत्तर राज्यों के युवाओं व किसानों के लिए आजीविका क्लस्टर, बांस उद्योग व कौशल विकास
schemes.description: High-impact central scheme filling developmental gaps and promoting livelihoods in all eight North Eastern states.

schemes.name: UDAN (Ude Desh Ka Aam Nagrik - Regional Connectivity)
schemes.nameHindi: उड़ान योजना (उड़े देश का आम नागरिक)
schemes.brief: Capped affordable flight airfares (₹2,500/hour) connecting 500+ unserved regional routes
schemes.briefHindi: छोटे शहरों के लिए किफायती हवाई यात्रा — 1 घंटे की उड़ान का किराया अधिकतम ₹2,500 निर्धारित
schemes.benefit: Air travel made affordable for common citizens with fare capped at ₹2,500 per seat per hour of flying on regional routes connecting tier-2 & tier-3 cities
schemes.benefitHindi: छोटे शहरों से बड़े महानगरों तक किफायती टिकट दर पर रियायती हवाई सेवा
documents: Government Photo ID Card / Aadhaar Card
schemes.description: Regional airport development and air connectivity program making flying accessible to common citizens across India.

schemes.name: PRASHAD Scheme (Pilgrimage & Heritage Tourism)
schemes.nameHindi: प्रसाद योजना (तीर्थयात्रा कायाकल्प और आध्यात्मिक संवर्धन अभियान)
schemes.brief: World-class amenities, clean restrooms, drinking water, and e-carts for senior pilgrims
schemes.briefHindi: तीर्थस्थलों पर वरिष्ठ नागरिकों व तीर्थयात्रियों हेतु मुफ्त ई-कार्ट, स्वच्छ पेयजल व विश्राम गृह
schemes.benefit: Integrated development of pilgrimage sites providing battery-operated carts for elderly and disabled pilgrims, clean rest houses, and tourist facilitation centers
schemes.benefitHindi: वरिष्ठ व दिव्यांग तीर्थयात्रियों हेतु बैटरी चालित निःशुल्क गाड़ियां, शेल्टर और सुगम मार्ग
documents: No documents required — open to all public
apply_mode: Public facilities directly available at designated pilgrimage shrines across India

schemes.name: Sagarmala Coastal Community Development
schemes.department: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
schemes.brief: Free maritime, fisheries, and logistics skill training with placement for coastal youth
schemes.briefHindi: तटीय क्षेत्रों के युवाओं को बंदरगाह, लॉजिस्टिक्स व समुद्री व्यापार में 100% मुफ्त कौशल प्रशिक्षण
schemes.benefit: Free job-linked vocational training in port operations, maritime seafaring, and cold-chain aquaculture logistics, with placement assurance in maritime companies
schemes.benefitHindi: समुद्र तटीय युवाओं को उच्च वेतन वाली नौकरियों हेतु मरीन व लॉजिस्टिक्स ट्रेनिंग व प्लेसमेंट
schemes.description: Skill development and economic upliftment initiative specifically designed for coastal fishing communities.

schemes.name: PM MITRA Mega Textile Parks Scheme
schemes.nameHindi: पीएम मित्र मेगा टेक्सटाइल पार्क योजना
schemes.brief: Subsidized factory space, power and training for handloom weavers and textile startups
schemes.briefHindi: बुनकरों व कपड़ा उद्यमियों को विश्वस्तरीय कार्यशालाएं, सस्ती बिजली और प्रशिक्षण सहायता
schemes.benefit: Plug-and-play modern industrial sheds, zero electricity duty for 5 years, subsidized capital credit for textile machinery, creating 1 lakh jobs per park
schemes.benefitHindi: कपड़ा व हथकरघा इकाइयों हेतु रेडी-टू-यूज शेड, सस्ती बिजली और मशीनरी पर ऋण सहायता
schemes.description: Creates state-of-the-art integrated textile parks providing world-class infrastructure to handloom weavers and apparel makers.
